interpretation_1: The director wanted a softer, less forceful musical note.
interpretation_2: The speaker treats note as a written note and switches to stationery that is physically lighter or thinner.

surface_text: Airline pilots make many friends in high places.
The mechanic said my report was missing a key part, so I revised the conclusion and checked under the seat for lost metal.
interpretation_1_zh: 这里是说报告缺少关键部分，比如结论或核心信息。
interpretation_1_en: Here, key means an essential or crucial part of the report is missing.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时 key 也会让人想到汽车钥匙，所以又去座位底下找金属钥匙。
interpretation_2_en: At the same time, key naturally evokes a car key, so checking under the seat also makes sense.
context: mechanic, report, revised the conclusion, checked under the seat for lost metal
literal_translation: 机械师说我的报告少了一个关键部分，所以我修改了结论，并到座位下面找丢失的金属物。
functional_equivalence_translation: 机械师说我的报告少了“key”部分，于是我一边改结论，一边去座位底下找那把丢了的钥匙。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 key part 一方面理解为“关键部分”，另一方面又把 key 单独激活为“钥匙”，再结合 mechanic 和 lost metal，让人误会成在找掉在座位下的金属钥匙。
interpretation_1: 报告缺少一个关键部分。
interpretation_2: 机械师所说的 part 被理解成金属零件，而 key 被联想到丢失的金属钥匙。

surface_text: The pastry chef likes a crisp finish, on the tart and in her emails.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是指挞的收尾口感要酥脆利落。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the tart should end with a crisp texture.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是指她写邮件时也喜欢简洁、干脆的结尾。
interpretation_2_en: It also means she prefers emails to end in a concise, sharp way.
context: Pastry chef; tart; emails; the phrase applies both to pastry texture and writing style.
literal_translation: 那位糕点师喜欢一种酥脆的收尾，不管是在水果塔上，还是在她的电子邮件里。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位糕点师讲究“收尾要脆”——做塔皮要脆，写邮件也要利落。
explanatory_translation: 这里的“crisp finish”形成并置双关：对水果塔来说，指成品口感酥脆；对邮件来说，指结尾简洁利落、干净明快。
interpretation_1: A tart should have a crisp, crunchy finishing texture.
interpretation_2: Her emails should end in a crisp, concise, polished way.

surface_text: The sleepy bakery launched a new breakfast combo and called it a yawnwich special.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是面包店推出了一款新的三明治早餐特餐。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the bakery introduces a new sandwich breakfast special.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把 sandwich 改成 yawnwich，暗示这是给困倦早晨吃的、让人打哈欠的早餐。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden reading turns sandwich into yawnwich, suggesting a sleepy morning meal linked to yawning.
context: 一家 sleepy bakery 推出新的 breakfast combo，并把它命名为 a yawnwich special。
literal_translation: 这家困倦的面包店推出了一款新的早餐套餐，并把它叫做“哈欠三明治”特餐。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家犯困的面包店推出早餐组合，起名叫“哈欠治”特餐。
explanatory_translation: 这家困倦的面包店推出了一款新的早餐套餐，并把它命名为“yawnwich special”，把 yawn（打哈欠）和 sandwich（三明治）拼在一起制造双关。
interpretation_1: 一种被命名为 yawnwich 的早餐三明治特餐。
interpretation_2: 用 yawn 暗示这家面包店很困倦、早餐让人联想到打哈欠。

surface_text: A pirate with one hand often picked up the phone. He wanted to get off the hook.
Hiring managers can be difficult.
Stolen painting found by tree.
The marine biologist said my apology needed to be more currential, so I updated the facts and wrote it from the tide pool.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是道歉内容需要更及时、更跟上最新情况。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the apology needed to be more current and up to date.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是说话人是海洋生物学家，currential 让人联想到海流、水流。
interpretation_2_en: Implicitly, the coinage evokes ocean currents, fitting the marine context.
context: A marine biologist comments on an apology; later phrases like “updated the facts” and “from the tide pool” activate both formal-writing and ocean-current meanings.
literal_translation: 那位海洋生物学家说我的道歉需要更“currential”一些，所以我更新了事实，并且在潮池边写下了它。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位海洋生物学家说我的道歉还不够“有资历”，也不够“合水流”，于是我润色了内容，坐在潮池边重写了一版。
explanatory_translation: 海洋生物学家说我的道歉需要更“currential”一点：这个自造词同时让人想到 credential（更正式、更有说服力）和 current（洋流、水流）。所以后文用 updated 和 tide pool 来配合这个海洋语境双关。
interpretation_1: The apology needed to be more formal or credible, as if it needed better credentials.
interpretation_2: The apology needed to be more related to water currents, fitting the marine setting.

surface_text: When the baby bird penned his first novel he was just a fledgling author .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说这只雏鸟写下第一部小说时，还只是一只羽翼未丰的小鸟作者。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that when the baby bird wrote his first novel, he was literally a young bird author that had not fully grown yet.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是“fledgling author”也指“初出茅庐、刚起步的新手作家”，借用了 fledgling 既能指幼鸟又能指新人的双重含义。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that a “fledgling author” is also a beginner or novice writer, using the word “fledgling” to mean both a young bird and someone just starting out.
context: A baby bird writes his first novel, so “fledgling” can describe both his literal bird age and his novice status as an author.
literal_translation: 当那只雏鸟写下他的第一部小说时，他还只是个初出茅庐的作者。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那只小鸟刚写第一本小说时，还只是个“雏鸟”作者。
explanatory_translation: 当那只幼鸟写出第一部小说时，他还是个“fledgling author”——fledgling 既指真正的雏鸟，也指刚起步的新手作者。
interpretation_1: A young bird that has just developed wing feathers and is learning to fly.
interpretation_2: A beginner or novice author at the start of a writing career.

surface_text: The cybersecurity team calls cautious optimism encryptagement.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是，网安团队把一种谨慎但积极的态度叫作“加密式鼓励”。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the cybersecurity team labels cautious optimism as a kind of 'encrypted encouragement.'
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是把 encrypt（加密）和 encouragement（鼓励）拼在一起，说明他们连打气都带着安全意识。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden reading blends 'encrypt' with 'encouragement,' suggesting that even their motivation comes wrapped in security-minded habits.
context: A cybersecurity team is describing cautious optimism and coins a tech-flavored word for it.
literal_translation: 网络安全团队把谨慎的乐观称为“加密励”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 网络安全团队把谨慎乐观叫作“密励”。
explanatory_translation: 网络安全团队把谨慎的乐观戏称为“encryptagement”，这是把 encouragement（鼓励、振奋）和 encrypt/encryption（加密）揉在一起的双关说法。
interpretation_1: A playful term for encouragement or optimism.
interpretation_2: The optimism is framed in a cybersecurity way by invoking encryption.

surface_text: A prisoner's favorite punctuation mark is the period . It marks the end of his sentence .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，囚犯最喜欢的标点符号是句号，因为句号标志着一个句子的结束。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that a prisoner's favorite punctuation mark is the period because it marks the end of a sentence.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是，sentence 也可以指法院判给囚犯的刑期，所以句号也象征着他服刑期的结束。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that 'sentence' can also mean a prison term given by a court, so the period also symbolizes the end of his jail sentence.
context: A prisoner is being discussed, and the word "period" is linked both to punctuation and to the ending of his sentence.
negative_example: A prisoner's favorite punctuation mark is the comma because it gives him a pause.
literal_translation: 一个囚犯最喜欢的标点符号是句号。它标志着他的句子的结束。
functional_equivalence_translation: 囚犯最喜欢句号，因为它意味着他的刑期到头了。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 sentence 一词双关：表面上指“句子”，所以句号标志句子结束；隐含上指“刑期/判刑”，所以句号也象征囚犯刑期结束。
interpretation_1: A punctuation mark ends a written sentence.
interpretation_2: A period marks the end of a prison sentence, meaning the term of punishment is over.

surface_text: The mushroom is a vegetable of high morel standing .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说，这种蘑菇是一种具有很高“羊肚菌地位”的蔬菜，像是在用蘑菇种类来形容它的身份很高。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says the mushroom is a vegetable of high 'morel standing,' as if its status is described using the mushroom type morel.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是套用了固定说法“moral standing”，意思是这朵蘑菇“地位高、很体面”；其中 morel 与 moral 同音，形成双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the phrase 'moral standing,' meaning high status or respectability; 'morel' sounds like 'moral,' creating the pun.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话者在评价蘑菇，并把常见短语“of high moral standing”改成与蘑菇相关的“morel”。
literal_translation: 这种蘑菇是一个具有很高“羊肚菌/道德”地位的蔬菜。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这蘑菇真是“德高望重”，因为它本来就是羊肚菌那一挂的。
explanatory_translation: 这里把固定说法“of high moral standing（道德高尚/声望很高）”中的 moral 换成了同音词 morel。morel 指羊肚菌，是一种蘑菇，因此形成了与蘑菇相关的双关。
interpretation_1: The sentence appears to say the mushroom has high moral standing, meaning high ethical status or respectability.
interpretation_2: It actually evokes morel, a kind of mushroom, so the praise is tied to the mushroom category itself.

surface_text: A gambling gardener usually hedges his bets .
interpretation_1_zh: 一个爱赌博的园丁通常会给自己的赌注留后路、分散风险，不把结果押在单一选择上。
interpretation_1_en: A gambling gardener usually hedges his bets, meaning he plays it safe by reducing risk and not committing everything to one outcome.
interpretation_2_zh: 这里又借用了园艺里的“hedges（树篱）”意思，暗示这个园丁会用树篱来“处理”或围住他的赌注，形成园丁身份与赌博表达的双关。
interpretation_2_en: It also evokes the gardening sense of “hedges,” suggesting that as a gardener he literally deals with hedges, creating a pun between the gambling idiom and his profession.
context: gardener 与 gambling/bets 同时出现，触发 hedge 的园艺义与博彩中的规避风险义
literal_translation: 一个爱赌博的园丁通常会给自己的赌注做对冲，也会修剪树篱。
functional_equivalence_translation: 一个赌徒园丁总会一边给赌注留后路，一边打理篱笆。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 hedges 一语双关：表面上指在赌博中“对冲、两头下注以降低风险”，同时因为说的是 gardener，又让人想到“修剪树篱”。
interpretation_1: to reduce risk by making cautious or offsetting bets
interpretation_2: to trim or deal with hedges as a gardener

surface_text: A play, based on billiards, started right on cue.
The cafe owner loves regulars, in the morning orders and in the monthly bookkeeping.
interpretation_1_zh: 咖啡馆老板喜欢常来的老顾客。
interpretation_1_en: The cafe owner loves regular customers who come in often.
interpretation_2_zh: 也指账本里有稳定、规律的收入项目。
interpretation_2_en: It also refers to regular, recurring entries in the monthly books.
context: 咖啡馆老板既喜欢早晨常来的老顾客，也喜欢账本里每月稳定重复出现的常规订单记录。
literal_translation: 这位咖啡馆老板喜欢 regulars：既是早晨下单的人，也是每月记账里的那些 regulars。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位咖啡馆老板最爱“常客”，也最爱账本里的“常规单”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 regulars 一方面指咖啡馆的常客，另一方面借指账本中规律、固定出现的订单或条目，形成并置双关。
interpretation_1: 忠实常来的顾客
interpretation_2: 固定、规律出现的订单项目或常规订单

surface_text: OLD WRESTLERS never die they just lose their grip .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说老摔跤手不会死，他们只是失去了抓握对手的力气或手上的抓力。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says old wrestlers never die; they just lose their grip, meaning they can no longer physically hold or grasp their opponents well.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是套用常见说法“老人不是死去，只是逐渐失去控制力/把握力”，其中 grip 也可表示掌控能力、控制力，带有年老衰退的意味。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the common formula that old people do not die but simply lose their hold on things; here, 'grip' also means control or command, suggesting the decline that comes with age.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：谈论年老摔跤手的衰老与职业特征，利用 grip 同时指身体抓握和抽象控制。
literal_translation: 老摔跤手永远不会死，他们只是失去了抓力。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老摔跤手不会消失，只是渐渐抓不住了。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 grip 一语双关，既指摔跤时的抓握力，也可引申为控制力；意思是老摔跤手不是“死了”，而是年纪大了，逐渐抓不牢、也不再像从前那样能掌控比赛。
interpretation_1: 老摔跤手身体衰老后抓握力变差，握不住对手。
interpretation_2: 套用“never die, they just ...”句式，表示他们并非消失，而是逐渐失去控制力或竞技能力。

surface_text: A gossip is someone with a great sense of rumor.
The music archivist arranged the vinyl shelves with recordination.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是档案管理员整理唱片架时很有条理、协调性很强。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the archivist organized the shelves with excellent coordination.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是这里的协调感和“record（唱片）”绑定，构成唱片语境下的新词。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the organizing skill is fused with 'record,' creating a record-specific form of coordination.
context: music archivist arranging vinyl shelves; 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 那位音乐档案管理员用“唱片式协调”整理了黑胶唱片架。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位音乐档案管理员整理黑胶架时展现了十足的“盘然有序”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的双关词是“recordination”，由“record”和“coordination”混成，既表示整理得很有条理，也点出对象是唱片。
interpretation_1: the shelves were arranged with careful coordination
interpretation_2: the arrangement is specifically about records, so coordination is blended with record

surface_text: The IT lead wanted cleaner code, so the intern wiped the fingerprints off the monitor.
interpretation_1_zh: 技术负责人想要更整洁、更规范的代码。
interpretation_1_en: The IT lead meant code that is more organized, readable, and well-structured.
interpretation_2_zh: “cleaner”也被理解成物理上的更干净，于是实习生去擦显示器上的指纹。
interpretation_2_en: “Cleaner” is also interpreted literally as physically cleaner, so the intern wipes the monitor.
context: In a programming workplace, “cleaner code” normally refers to software quality, but the following clause about wiping fingerprints off the monitor activates a literal cleaning reading.
negative_example: The IT lead wanted cleaner code, so the intern deleted the extra comments.
literal_translation: IT 主管想要更干净的代码，所以实习生把显示器上的指纹擦掉了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 技术主管说代码要更“干净”，结果实习生真去把屏幕擦干净了。
explanatory_translation: IT lead means “cleaner code” in the software sense—more readable and better organized—but the intern takes “cleaner” literally as physical cleaning, so he wipes fingerprints off the monitor.
interpretation_1: The IT lead wants code that is well-structured, readable, and free of unnecessary issues.
interpretation_2: The intern misunderstands it as a request to literally clean something physical and wipes the monitor.

surface_text: My dentist prefers sharp patients, so I stayed alert in the chair and arrived in a very neat suit.
interpretation_1_zh: 我的牙医喜欢反应敏捷、注意力集中的病人，所以我在诊疗椅上保持清醒。
interpretation_1_en: My dentist prefers alert, attentive patients, so I stayed focused in the chair.
interpretation_2_zh: sharp 也能表示“穿着利落、精神”，所以我穿了一套很整洁的西装去。
interpretation_2_en: Sharp can also mean stylish and well-dressed, so I arrived in a neat suit.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：牙医说他喜欢“sharp patients”，说话人于是既保持警觉地坐在牙椅上，又穿着整洁得体地到来。
negative_example: My dentist prefers smart patients, so I stayed alert in the chair.
literal_translation: 我的牙医更喜欢“sharp”的病人，所以我在牙椅上保持警觉，而且穿着非常整洁的西装到来。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我的牙医喜欢“利落”的病人，于是我一边在牙椅上打起精神，一边穿得笔挺去看牙。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 sharp 一语双关：一层是“警觉、机敏”，对应说话人在牙椅上保持清醒；另一层是“穿着利落、很时髦”，对应他穿着整洁西装去看牙。
interpretation_1: mentally alert and attentive
interpretation_2: well-dressed, stylish, and neat in appearance

surface_text: The photograph that I took of the sandstorm turned out grainy .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说我拍的那张沙尘暴照片成像粗糙，画面颗粒感很重，不够清晰。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the photo I took of the sandstorm came out coarse and full of visual noise or grain.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是因为拍摄对象本身就是沙尘暴，"grainy" 又让人联想到沙粒般的颗粒，既指照片有颗粒感，也呼应了沙子本身。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that since the subject is a sandstorm, "grainy" also evokes actual grains of sand, linking the photo's visual graininess to the sandy scene itself.
context: A photo was taken of a sandstorm, so "grainy" can describe both photo texture and suggest sand grains.
literal_translation: 我拍的那张沙尘暴照片结果显得很有颗粒感。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我拍的那张沙尘暴照片，出来后真是“满屏沙粒感”。
explanatory_translation: 我拍的那张沙尘暴照片结果很有颗粒感；这里的 grainy 一方面指照片画质粗糙、有颗粒，另一方面又让人联想到沙尘暴里的沙粒。
interpretation_1: The photograph came out grainy, meaning rough or speckled in image quality.
interpretation_2: Because the subject was a sandstorm, grainy also evokes actual grains of sand.

surface_text: After coming to work and play musicians come home suite home.
Cheap food and wine can ruin a date.
At a flower show the first prize is often a bloom ribbon .
interpretation_1_zh: 在花展上，第一名奖品常被说成是“花朵缎带”，也就是和花有关的奖带。
interpretation_1_en: At a flower show, the first prize is described as a “bloom ribbon,” a ribbon associated with flowers.
interpretation_2_zh: 这里影射固定说法“blue ribbon”，即一等奖或头奖；把 blue 改成 bloom，呼应花展主题，形成双关。
interpretation_2_en: It plays on the phrase “blue ribbon,” which means first prize; replacing “blue” with “bloom” fits the flower-show setting and creates the pun.
context: flower show; first prize ribbon
literal_translation: 在花展上，头等奖通常是一条“盛开”丝带。
functional_equivalence_translation: 在花展上，头奖常常是“花魁丝带”。
explanatory_translation: 在花展上，头等奖常说成“bloom ribbon”，这是把固定说法“blue ribbon（蓝丝带，指头奖）”替换成与花有关的“bloom”，形成双关。
interpretation_1: At a flower show, the first prize ribbon is described as related to blooming flowers.
interpretation_2: It echoes the fixed expression "blue ribbon," meaning first prize.

surface_text: My friend's bakery burned down last night . Now his business is toast .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是，他朋友的面包店昨晚被烧了，现在他的生意真的变成了烤吐司或被烤焦的面包。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that after the bakery burned down, his business is literally toast, meaning burnt bread or toasted bread.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是英语习语“be toast”，表示他的生意完了、毁了，已经没救了。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is the idiom “be toast,” which means his business is finished, ruined, or doomed.
context: A bakery burned down last night, so saying the business is toast links financial ruin with burned bread.
literal_translation: 我朋友的面包店昨晚烧毁了。现在他的生意是吐司了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我朋友的面包店昨晚失火了，现在他的生意算是彻底烤糊了。
explanatory_translation: 我朋友的面包店昨晚烧掉了，现在他的生意完了；这里的“toast”既可表示“完蛋了”，又让人想到被烤焦的面包。
interpretation_1: The business is ruined or finished.
interpretation_2: The bakery business is literally associated with toasted bread after the fire.

surface_text: A baseball player was a thief . He was always trying to steal .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说这个棒球运动员像小偷一样，总是在偷东西。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says the baseball player was like a thief and was always trying to steal things.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是利用棒球术语“steal”的双关，指他总是试图盗垒，而不是普通意义上的偷窃。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that in baseball, “steal” means to steal a base, so he was always trying to advance by stealing bases rather than committing ordinary theft.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话对象既是棒球运动员，又被描述为像小偷；英语中 steal 可指偷窃，也可指偷垒。
negative_example: He was always trying to rob.
literal_translation: 一个棒球运动员是个小偷。他总是在试图偷。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个棒球运动员简直像个贼，因为他老想着“偷”垒。
explanatory_translation: 这句话利用了 steal 的双义：表面上是“偷东西”，在棒球里还表示“偷垒”，所以把棒球运动员说成“小偷”。
interpretation_1: He kept trying to commit theft.
interpretation_2: As a baseball player, he kept trying to steal bases.

surface_text: A baseball player can sell himself to a new team if he has a good pitch.
My name is Chuck , I'm a butcher .
interpretation_1_zh: 说话者在做自我介绍：他叫 Chuck，而且他的职业是屠夫。
interpretation_1_en: The speaker is introducing himself: his name is Chuck, and he is a butcher.
interpretation_2_zh: “Chuck”也是牛肩胛肉、肩胛部位牛肉的名称，和屠夫的职业形成关联，暗示他的名字正好像一种肉类部位名。
interpretation_2_en: "Chuck" is also the name of a cut of beef from the shoulder, which connects to his job as a butcher and makes his name sound like a meat term.
context: 自我介绍中先说名字，再说明自己是 butcher，因此姓名 Chuck 会激活肉块名称 chuck 的联想。
negative_example: My name is Chuck, I'm a baker.
literal_translation: 我叫Chuck，我是个屠夫。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我叫查克，正好也是卖查克肉的屠夫。
explanatory_translation: 我叫Chuck，是个屠夫。这里 Chuck 既是人名，又让人联想到牛肉部位 chuck，因此形成双关。
interpretation_1: Chuck is the speaker's personal name.
interpretation_2: chuck refers to a cut of beef, fitting a butcher's profession.

surface_text: When old story tellers die they are mythed .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上看，这句话是在说：当老故事讲述者去世时，他们就“变成了神话”或被神话化了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the sentence says that when old storytellers die, they become mythic or are turned into myth.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把 mythed 故意写成与 missed 同音的形式，实际激活了“他们会被怀念、被想念”的意思，同时又和讲故事、神话传说相关联。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that "mythed" is a playful substitute for "missed," suggesting that they are missed when they die, while also linking them to myths and storytelling.
context: old story tellers die
literal_translation: 当老讲故事的人去世时，他们被“神话了”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 当老说书人离世，人们不只是想念他们，也像把他们写进了神话。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 missed 改成近音的 mythed，一方面让人理解为“他们被怀念”，另一方面借 myth 表达“讲故事的人仿佛进入了神话”。
interpretation_1: When old storytellers die, people miss them.
interpretation_2: Because storytellers are associated with myths, saying they are 'mythed' links their death to myth-making.

surface_text: A tailor sometimes decides to suit himself.
A skier who loses a race on a cold day will have a frosty disposition .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，一个在寒冷天气里输掉比赛的滑雪者，会因为天气很冷而显得带着冰霜般的状态或气息。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that a skier who loses a race on a cold day will have an icy or frost-covered condition because of the cold weather.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是说，这个滑雪者输了比赛后会心情不好、态度冷淡或脾气不佳；“frosty”也可以形容人态度冷冰冰的。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the skier will be upset, cold in manner, or unfriendly after losing the race; “frosty” also describes a chilly or unfriendly attitude.
context: A skier loses a race on a cold day, linking physical coldness with an emotionally cold attitude.
literal_translation: 一个滑雪者在寒冷的一天输掉比赛后，会有一种冰冷的性情。
functional_equivalence_translation: 滑雪者在冷天输了比赛，脾气也会变得很“冷”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的frosty一方面指天气寒冷、像结霜一样冷，另一方面指人因为输掉比赛而态度冷淡、心情不快。
interpretation_1: having a cold or chilly condition because of the cold weather
interpretation_2: being unfriendly, cold, or resentful after losing

surface_text: A cat found a mysterious sweater, but the mystery was soon unravelled.
The software team wanted a lighter build, so they trimmed the app and stopped carrying the desktop upstairs.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是：软件团队想要一个更轻量的程序版本，于是精简了应用。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the software team wanted a lighter software build, so they reduced the app's size or complexity.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：他们也不再搬那台沉重的台式机上楼，像是在说更轻的电脑整机配置。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that build also suggests a physical computer build, so they literally stopped carrying the heavy desktop upstairs.
context: 软件团队想要更轻量的版本，后文又说不再把 desktop 搬上楼，把软件构建与实体重量并置
literal_translation: 软件团队想要一个更轻的构建，所以他们精简了应用程序，也不再把桌面搬到楼上。
functional_equivalence_translation: 软件团队想做个更轻量的版本，于是把应用瘦身了，连“桌面”都不用再往楼上搬了。
explanatory_translation: 软件团队想要一个更轻量的构建版本，于是他们精简了应用。后半句故意把 desktop 当成真的桌子或台式机来理解，制造出“轻量软件”和“物理变轻”的双关。
interpretation_1: a smaller, less resource-heavy software build
interpretation_2: physically lighter in weight, as if the app or desktop were objects to carry

surface_text: Olivia interviewed the actress from Paris.
At the robotics lab, they wanted a more responsive arm, so we tuned the motor and hired a better wave.
interpretation_1_zh: 实验室希望机械臂更灵敏，所以我们调校了电机。
interpretation_1_en: The lab wanted the robotic arm to react better, so we adjusted the motor.
interpretation_2_zh: arm也让人想到人的手臂动作，所以后半句把“挥手”也当成了可改进的对象。
interpretation_2_en: Arm also suggests a human arm, so the joke extends to improving the quality of a wave.
context: A robotics lab is trying to make a robotic arm more responsive; one solution is technical tuning of the motor, and the second clause introduces the punning contrast with 'hired a better wave'.
literal_translation: 在机器人实验室，他们想要一只反应更灵敏的手臂，所以我们调校了马达，还雇了一个更好的挥手。
functional_equivalence_translation: 在机器人实验室，他们想让机械臂更灵，所以一边调电机，一边找了个更会“挥/批”的人。
explanatory_translation: 在机器人实验室，他们想让机械臂更灵敏，所以我们调了马达，还“雇了个更好的 wave”。这里的 wave 表面上指挥手动作，和机械臂呼应；同时又借近音让人联想到 waiver 一类词，形成并置式双关。
interpretation_1: They hired someone or something better at waving, fitting the robot arm context literally.
interpretation_2: It echoes hiring a better 'waiver', as if an administrative or approval element were being improved alongside the motor.

surface_text: The mechanic wanted a smoother ride, so I fixed the suspension and stopped complaining in the passenger seat.
interpretation_1_zh: 修车师傅想让车开起来更平稳，所以我修好了悬挂系统。
interpretation_1_en: The mechanic meant the car should ride more smoothly, so I fixed the suspension.
interpretation_2_zh: ride 也指乘车体验，所以我也不再坐在副驾一路抱怨，让这趟路更顺心。
interpretation_2_en: Ride also refers to the overall trip experience, so I stopped complaining from the passenger seat.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：一位 mechanic 想要更平稳的乘坐体验，话语同时提到车辆维修和乘客抱怨两个层面。
negative_example: The mechanic wanted a smoother ride, so I fixed the brakes and stopped complaining in the passenger seat.
literal_translation: 那个机械师想要更平稳的乘坐体验，所以我修好了悬挂系统，并且不再坐在乘客座位上抱怨了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 机械师想坐得更稳，我一边修好悬挂，一边也把自己这个爱抱怨的乘客“修”安静了。
explanatory_translation: 这里把“让乘坐更平稳”并置为两个层面：表面上是修汽车的悬挂系统，隐含上是说话人停止抱怨，从而让乘车气氛也更“平稳”。
interpretation_1: The mechanic repaired the car's suspension system to make the ride smoother.
interpretation_2: The speaker also ended the unpleasant 'suspension' of comfort by stopping their own complaints as a passenger.

surface_text: Those who make sponges get very absorbed in their work .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，制作海绵的人在工作中会变得很会吸收，就像海绵一样。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that people who make sponges become very absorbent in their work, like sponges themselves.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是说，制作海绵的人非常专注、全神贯注地投入工作中，因为 absorbed 也有“专心投入”的意思。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that people who make sponges are deeply engaged or fully immersed in their work, since absorbed also means mentally engrossed.
context: People who manufacture sponges are being described.
literal_translation: 那些制作海绵的人对工作非常投入。
functional_equivalence_translation: 做海绵的人干活总是特别“投入”，毕竟海绵最会“吸收”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 absorbed 表面上表示“全神贯注、很投入”，同时又让人联想到海绵“吸收液体”的性质，因此形成语义双关。
interpretation_1: They are very engrossed in their work.
interpretation_2: Because they make sponges, the idea of absorbing liquid is implicitly activated.

surface_text: The aquarium café just launched a new shellf-service counter.
interpretation_1_zh: 这家水族馆咖啡馆新开了一个自助服务柜台。
interpretation_1_en: The aquarium café has opened a new self-service counter.
interpretation_2_zh: 由于场景和海洋生物有关，self 被改成 shellf，带出贝壳和海鲜意象。
interpretation_2_en: Because the setting is aquatic, 'self-service' becomes 'shellf-service,' adding shell/sea life imagery.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：aquarium café 推出一个与海洋生物主题相关的自助柜台。
literal_translation: 这家水族馆咖啡馆刚推出了一个新的“贝壳式自助”柜台。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家水族馆咖啡馆刚推出了一个新的“壳助式”取餐柜台。
explanatory_translation: 这家水族馆咖啡馆刚推出了一个新的自助柜台；这里把 self-service 改成了 shellf-service，借 shell（贝壳）/ shellfish（贝类）来制造海洋主题双关。
interpretation_1: A counter where customers serve themselves.
interpretation_2: The service is themed around shells or shellfish, fitting an aquarium café.

surface_text: The night-shift security guard stayed awake through pure alarmfulness.
interpretation_1_zh: 夜班保安全靠高度警觉撑着不睡。
interpretation_1_en: The night security guard stayed awake through sheer alertness and vigilance.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个词把 alarm 和带有状态感的词尾拼在一起，像是在说一种“警报式清醒”。
interpretation_2_en: The coinage builds from 'alarm,' suggesting a kind of wakefulness powered by alarm-like readiness.
context: 夜班保安需要保持清醒，并与警报系统相关。
literal_translation: 那个夜班保安纯靠“警报fulness”一直保持清醒。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个夜班保安整夜没睡，全靠一股“警觉+警报”的劲儿。
explanatory_translation: 这里把常规的“alertness（警觉）”改造成“alarmfulness”，把“alarm（警报）”嵌进去，既表示他很清醒，又呼应保安与警报系统的工作环境。
interpretation_1: The guard stayed awake because he was very alert.
interpretation_2: The wakefulness is humorously framed as coming from alarms, fitting a security guard context.

surface_text: Ancient scribes who hired Aztec writers had to make sure the Inca was dry .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，雇用阿兹特克写手的古代抄写员必须确保印加人的墨水已经干了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that ancient scribes who hired Aztec writers had to make sure the Inca ink was dry.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把“Inca”当作“ink”来谐音替换，真正想表达的是他们得确保墨水干了。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a sound-based substitution: “Inca” echoes “ink,” so it really means they had to make sure the ink was dry.
context: Ancient scribes hired Aztec writers, and the sentence says they had to make sure the Inca was dry, which activates a sound-based reading of ink in a writing context.
literal_translation: 雇用阿兹特克作家的古代抄写员必须确保印加是干的。
functional_equivalence_translation: 古代抄写员雇了阿兹特克写手后，得先确认“印卡/墨水”已经干了。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 Inca 和 ink 近音双关：表面上说“印加人/印加”，实际在抄写语境中指“墨水”，意思是要确保墨水已经干了。
interpretation_1: the name of the Inca civilization or an Inca person/writer
interpretation_2: ink used by scribes had to be dry

surface_text: What you can buy for a dollar these days is absolute noncents .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说，如今一美元能买到的东西简直是“没有几分钱的东西”，强调金额非常少、价值很低。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that what a dollar can buy these days is practically worth no cents, stressing how little money and value are involved.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把常用表达“nonsense”故意改成了“noncents”，借“cents”和“dollar”的金钱语境来讽刺：一美元如今能买到的东西荒谬得毫无意义。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a playful twist on the word “nonsense,” changed to “noncents” to match the money context of “cents” and “dollar,” implying that what a dollar buys nowadays is absurd or ridiculous.
context: Complaining that a dollar buys very little nowadays; based on the surface text, the minimal necessary context can be recovered.
literal_translation: 如今一美元能买到的东西简直是彻底的“无分/胡说”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 如今一块钱能买到的东西，简直少得荒唐。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 nonsense 改成了 noncents，利用 cents（分）与 sense 的近音，既表示“荒唐可笑”，又暗指“一美元连几分价值的东西都买不到多少”。
interpretation_1: It means something absurd or ridiculous.
interpretation_2: It suggests a lack of cents, referring to how little a dollar can buy now.

surface_text: The lamb is too hot to eat.
Those who get up at sunrise have many ideas dawn on them .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，那些在日出时起床的人，会有很多想法在黎明时分来到他们脑海中。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that people who get up at sunrise have many ideas come to them at dawn.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是利用了固定表达“dawn on”的双关，它本义并不是“天亮”，而是“渐渐被理解、突然明白”，也就是说早起的人容易灵机一动、想到很多点子。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the idiom "dawn on," which also means "to become clear" or "to occur to someone." So the sentence suggests that early risers have lots of ideas occur to them.
context: people who get up at sunrise
literal_translation: 那些在日出时起床的人，会有许多想法在他们身上破晓。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那些日出即起的人，灵感总会在破晓时分“亮”起来。
explanatory_translation: 这里利用了dawn on既可表示“突然被想到”，又让人联想到dawn“黎明、破晓”，与sunrise形成呼应。
interpretation_1: ideas suddenly occur to them
interpretation_2: the time of dawn is linked to people who get up at sunrise

surface_text: The boating store had its best sail ever .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说这家卖划船用品的商店创下了有史以来最好的一次“帆”相关业绩，好像在说船帆卖得特别好。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says the boating store had its best 'sail' ever, as if it did especially well with sails or sailing-related business.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把常见说法“best sale ever”故意写成了“sail”，实际是在说这家店创下了最佳销售业绩。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a play on 'best sale ever': 'sail' replaces 'sale,' so it really means the store had its best sales performance ever.
context: boating store；best ever；根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
negative_example: The boating store had its best seal ever.
literal_translation: 那家划船用品商店有史以来最好的“帆”一次。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那家船具店创下了史上最佳“帆/销”纪录。
explanatory_translation: 原句把 sale（销售额、销售业绩）写成与其同音的 sail（船帆），既表示这家船具店业绩最好，也呼应了航船主题。
interpretation_1: The boating store had its best sales event or strongest sales performance ever.
interpretation_2: Because it is a boating store, the wording evokes a sail on a boat.

surface_text: Our robotics captain gave a screwdential speech before the build-off.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是说队长发表了一番很有分量、很有资历感的演讲。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it suggests the captain gave an authoritative, credential-like speech.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是这场演讲充满了机器人制作语境，尤其让人想到螺丝和装配。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the speech was tied to robotics building, evoking screws and assembly work.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：机器人队长在比赛前发表讲话，场景与机械组装、螺丝等硬件相关。
literal_translation: 我们的机器人队队长在制作对决前发表了一场“螺凭式”演讲。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们机器人队长在开造前来了一场很“有钉有据”的演讲。
explanatory_translation: 我们的机器人队长在制作赛前发表了一场双关式演讲：screwdential混合了credential（像正式资历/官方口吻）和screw（螺丝），把正式讲话和机械硬件语境叠加在一起。
interpretation_1: It describes the speech as a credential-like or official captain's speech.
interpretation_2: It evokes screws and hardware, fitting a robotics build context.

surface_text: A butcher was trying so hard to be funny, but he just wasn't making the cut.
The weather app has become stormfully optimistic again.
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是在说天气应用又开始过分乐观地预报天气了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says the weather app has become overly optimistic again.
interpretation_2_zh: stormfully 把 storm 塞进副词中，暗示它明明面对暴风雨却还很乐观。
interpretation_2_en: The blended adverb inserts storm, suggesting the app sounds optimistic even when storms are involved.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话者在评价天气应用的预报措辞，认为它又对天气情况表现出过度乐观的判断。
negative_example: The weather app has become strongly optimistic again.
literal_translation: 那个天气应用又变得“风暴般地”乐观了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个天气应用又开始乐观得离谱了——还是带着“暴风雨味”的那种乐观。
explanatory_translation: 这里把常见说法 'awfully optimistic' 改成了 'stormfully optimistic'。表层上它让人想到 storm（风暴），契合天气应用语境；隐含上它模仿 awfully optimistic，表示“过分乐观、乐观得离谱”。
interpretation_1: In a weather-related way, the app is being optimistic with reference to storms.
interpretation_2: The sentence echoes 'awfully optimistic,' meaning excessively or ironically optimistic.

surface_text: The violin case comes with a handle and a lot of carriosity.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是这个琴盒让人很好奇，容易引发关注。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the violin case sparks curiosity and makes people interested.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是它很便于携带，carry 被嵌入了词里。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that it is easy to carry, with carry built into the word.
context: A violin case is being described as having a handle, so carrying it is salient; the invented word echoes curiosity while inserting carry.
literal_translation: 这个小提琴盒带有一个把手，还有很多“携奇心”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这只小提琴盒有把手，也特别让人“想拎又好奇”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 curiosity 改造成 carriosity，借 carry（携带）和 curiosity（好奇心）的近音/混成双关，呼应小提琴盒有把手、便于携带。
interpretation_1: The case supposedly inspires curiosity.
interpretation_2: The word blends in the idea of carrying, fitting a violin case with a handle.

surface_text: Our school gardener calls exam season testy growth.
interpretation_1_zh: 学校园丁把考试季形容成一种紧张烦躁的成长阶段。
interpretation_1_en: The gardener describes exam season as a period of irritable, stressed growth.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个表达改造自“steady growth”，把“test”嵌入后，变成了考试季特有的成长说法。
interpretation_2_en: The phrase reshapes 'steady growth' by activating 'test,' turning normal development into exam-driven growth.
context: 学校园丁谈论考试季，把园艺表达与考试情境结合；根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 我们学校的园丁把考试季叫做“暴躁的生长”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们学校的园丁把考试季叫做“考式生长”，像在说“稳式生长”却换成了和考试相关的说法。
explanatory_translation: 我们学校的园丁把考试季称为“testy growth”。表面上是“烦躁、紧张的成长”，同时谐拟园艺里更常见的“steady growth（稳定生长）”，因为这里是考试季，所以把 steady 换成了 testy。
interpretation_1: The gardener describes exam season as a period of irritable or tense growth.
interpretation_2: It echoes 'steady growth,' a gardener's familiar phrase about healthy plant development, replacing 'steady' with 'testy' because of tests.

surface_text: A mechanic who was also a musician was good at tuning things.
The pastry chef called her emergency frosting kit whiskurance.
interpretation_1_zh: 那位糕点师把她的应急糖霜工具包当作一种保障。
interpretation_1_en: The pastry chef treated her emergency frosting kit as a kind of insurance.
interpretation_2_zh: whiskurance 把 whisk 和 insurance 拼在一起，表示这是烘焙专属的“保险”。
interpretation_2_en: The blend combines whisk and insurance, making it a baker's version of emergency coverage.
context: A pastry chef humorously names her emergency frosting kit with a blend involving a baking tool and insurance; 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 这位糕点师把她的紧急糖霜工具包称作“打蛋器保险”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位糕点师把她的紧急糖霜工具包叫作“打蛋险”。
explanatory_translation: The pastry chef called her emergency frosting kit “whiskurance,” a blend of “whisk” and “insurance,” suggesting the kit is like baking insurance for frosting emergencies.
interpretation_1: It names an emergency kit for frosting as if it were a kind of insurance.
interpretation_2: The word blends whisk, a baking tool, with insurance, implying protection for pastry emergencies.

surface_text: Daniel met the banker in the cafe.
A carpenter sat on his drill and was bored to tears.
The electrician got his supplies at the outlet store .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：那个电工在一家折扣奥特莱斯商店买到了他的用品。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the electrician bought his supplies at an outlet store, meaning a discount retail store.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：这里的 outlet 也让人想到电源插座或电器接口，因此和电工的职业形成双关，暗示他是在和电力相关的“outlet”那里买东西。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that outlet also means an electrical socket or power outlet, which connects directly to the electrician's profession and creates the pun.
context: An electrician is buying supplies, which makes the word outlet simultaneously suggest a retail outlet and an electrical outlet.
literal_translation: 那个电工在奥特莱斯商店买了他的用品。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个电工去“outlet”买材料，既像说折扣店，又让人想到电源插座。
explanatory_translation: 句中 outlet 表层指折扣店/直销店，但因为主语是 electrician，读者会同时联想到 electrical outlet（电源插座），形成语义双关。
interpretation_1: He bought supplies at a discount retail outlet store.
interpretation_2: Because he is an electrician, outlet also evokes an electrical socket related to his trade.

surface_text: The botanist likes fine specimens, especially in the greenhouse and at dinner parties.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是：植物学家喜欢优质的植物标本，尤其是在温室里。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the botanist enjoys fine biological specimens, especially plants in the greenhouse.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是：他也喜欢在晚宴上结识出色、体面的人物。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that he also enjoys distinguished people, especially at dinner parties.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：greenhouse 指向植物标本，dinner parties 指向对人的评价，从而激活 specimens 的双重指向。
literal_translation: 这位植物学家喜欢好的标本，尤其是在温室里和晚宴上。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位植物学家喜欢上等的“样本”——温室里是植物，晚宴上是人。
explanatory_translation: 这里 specimens 在温室语境中指植物标本，在晚宴语境中则幽默地指外表出众或令人欣赏的人，因此形成并置双关。
interpretation_1: The botanist likes high-quality plant samples, especially those in the greenhouse.
interpretation_2: The botanist also likes attractive or impressive people encountered at dinner parties.

surface_text: All students in Helsinki go to Finnish school.
The young prosecutor entered moot court with caseual confidence.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是这位年轻检察官在模拟法庭上显得从容自信。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the young prosecutor seemed casually confident in moot court.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是 caseual 由 case 和 casual 拼成，突出法律案件语境下的轻松自信。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning blends case and casual into caseual, signaling easy confidence in a legal case setting.
context: young prosecutor; entered moot court
literal_translation: 那位年轻的检察官带着“案件般的随意”自信走进了模拟法庭。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位年轻的检察官带着很“案”然的自信走进了模拟法庭。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 casual 改成了 caseual，表面像说他很从容自信，实际上嵌入了 case（案件），呼应检察官和模拟法庭的法律语境。
interpretation_1: He entered with casual confidence.
interpretation_2: His confidence is linked to legal cases, fitting a prosecutor in moot court.

surface_text: OLD HOUSEWIVES never die , they just wash away .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是：老家庭主妇不会死，她们只是被洗掉、像污渍一样随水冲走了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that old housewives never die; they simply wash away, as if they are washed off or carried away by water.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是仿照常见笑话句式“never die, they just ... away”，把家庭主妇与“洗衣、清洗”联系起来；“wash away”借家务中的“洗”来制造幽默，暗示她们只是以符合主妇身份的方式“退场”。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a playful twist on the stock joke pattern 'never die, they just ... away,' linking housewives to washing and laundry. 'Wash away' humorously gives them a stereotypically domestic way of disappearing.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：套用固定句式“X never die, they just pass away”，并将其中部分替换为与 housewives 日常家务相关的表达。
literal_translation: 老主妇从不死去，她们只是被洗没了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老主妇不会去世，她们只是“洗”世了。
explanatory_translation: 这句话仿照“they never die, they just pass away（他们不是死去，只是过世）”，把 pass away 换成 wash away，借主妇常洗衣做家务制造双关。
interpretation_1: Housewives are described as being associated with washing, so instead of dying they 'wash away'.
interpretation_2: It echoes the idiom 'never die, they just pass away', meaning they die euphemistically.

surface_text: The exhausted coder called our overnight release a debuglight shift.
interpretation_1_zh: 他说这次通宵发版像是在调试中熬到天亮的班次。
interpretation_1_en: He describes the overnight release as a shift spent debugging until daylight.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个造词也让人想到“daylight shift”，暗示夜班硬生生被干成了白班。
interpretation_2_en: The blend also evokes a daylight shift, implying the night work dragged on into morning.
context: A coder is exhausted and describes an overnight software release using a modified phrase related to shift work and debugging.
literal_translation: 那位筋疲力尽的程序员把我们的通宵发布叫作一次“调试光班”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位累坏的程序员把这次通宵发布叫作“调试班”，像把“白班”改成了程序员版说法。
explanatory_translation: 那位筋疲力尽的程序员把我们的通宵发布称为“debuglight shift”，这是把“daylight shift（白班）”和“debug shift（调试班）”混合起来的双关，既像在说班次，也强调整晚都在调试。
interpretation_1: It refers to an overnight work shift by blending the familiar phrase 'daylight shift' into a coding-related expression.
interpretation_2: It implies the release shift is dominated by debugging work, making it a 'debug shift'.

surface_text: Old colanders never die , they just can't take the strain anymore .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是旧滤盆不会死，只是再也承受不了过滤时的拉力或压力了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that old colanders never die; they just can no longer withstand the strain or stress involved in use.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是套用了常见说法“Old soldiers never die, they just fade away”，把“fade away”改成了和滤盆有关的“can't take the strain”，其中strain既指压力，也指“过滤、滤去”。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a parody of the saying 'Old soldiers never die, they just fade away,' replacing 'fade away' with 'can't take the strain,' where 'strain' means both pressure and the act of straining/filtering, which fits a colander.
context: Old colanders never die, they just can't take the strain anymore.
literal_translation: 旧滤盆从不死去，它们只是再也承受不了这种 strain 了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 旧漏勺不会死，只是再也经不起“过滤/压力”了。
explanatory_translation: 老旧的滤盆并非真的死去，而是再也承受不住使用的压力；同时 strain 也指“过滤”，呼应了滤盆的功能。
interpretation_1: The colanders are too old to withstand pressure or use anymore.
interpretation_2: A colander is used to strain food, so the line also evokes their literal function.

surface_text: The cat shelter's adoption fair was a total purrsuasion event.
interpretation_1_zh: 这场猫咪收容所的领养活动非常有说服力，让人很想领养。
interpretation_1_en: The cat shelter's adoption fair was highly persuasive and encouraged people to adopt.
interpretation_2_zh: purrsuasion 说明这种说服力来自猫咪的呼噜声和可爱表现。
interpretation_2_en: The blend suggests the persuasion came through the cats' purring and charm.
context: cat shelter's adoption fair
literal_translation: 这家猫咪收容所的领养集市完全是一场“呼噜式说服”活动。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家猫咪收容所的领养活动简直是一场“喵力劝领养”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 persuasion（说服）改成 purrsuasion，嵌入了 purr（猫呼噜声），既表示活动很能说服人来领养猫，也突出猫咪主题。
interpretation_1: The event was highly persuasive in encouraging people to adopt cats.
interpretation_2: The event is cat-themed, invoking the sound a cat makes through the inserted word “purr.”

surface_text: If a Monk throws a hissy fit , is it a temple tantrum ?
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是在问：如果一个和尚大发脾气，这能不能叫作“寺庙式的发脾气”或“和尚在寺庙里的闹脾气”。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it asks whether a monk throwing a hissy fit could be called a “temple tantrum,” meaning a tantrum related to a temple or by someone from a temple.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是仿照固定说法“temper tantrum”构成双关，把“temper”换成了与和尚相关的“temple”，利用两词字形和读音相近制造幽默。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a play on the common phrase “temper tantrum.” It replaces “temper” with “temple,” which is associated with a monk, creating humor through the similarity between the two expressions.
context: monk, throws a hissy fit, temple tantrum
literal_translation: 如果一个和尚大发脾气，那算是一次“寺庙式发脾气”吗？
functional_equivalence_translation: 如果和尚闹脾气，这算不算一场“庙”脾气？
explanatory_translation: 这里把固定说法“temper tantrum（发脾气）”中的 temper 换成了 temple，因为 monk 让人联想到 temple，于是形成双关。
interpretation_1: A monk's tantrum is described as a tantrum related to a temple.
interpretation_2: It echoes the fixed phrase 'temper tantrum' by replacing 'temper' with 'temple'.

surface_text: The chef requested a cooler plate, so I chilled the dish and toned down my reaction to his criticism.
interpretation_1_zh: 厨师要求盘子更凉一些，所以我把菜先冷却了。
interpretation_1_en: The chef wanted a colder plate, so I chilled the dish.
interpretation_2_zh: cooler 也可表示“更冷静”，所以我对他的批评反应也收敛了些。
interpretation_2_en: Cooler can also mean calmer in attitude, so I reacted more calmly to his criticism.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：chef asked for a cooler plate, which can mean a physically colder dish or a more restrained reaction to criticism
literal_translation: 厨师要求一个更凉的盘子，所以我把菜冷却了，也让自己对他批评的反应降温了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 厨师说要“更冷静/更冷”的菜，我一边把菜弄凉，一边也把自己被批评后的火气压了下去。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 cooler 一词并置了两层意思：一是温度上更凉，于是把菜冷却；二是情绪上更冷静，于是对批评的反应也变得克制。
interpretation_1: colder in temperature
interpretation_2: more calm or less emotional

surface_text: The gardener gave a dry lecture on watering, which was impressive in two directions.
interpretation_1_zh: “dry lecture”表示讲得枯燥乏味。
interpretation_1_en: "Dry lecture" means dull or unexciting.
interpretation_2_zh: “dry”也表示干燥、没水，而主题偏偏是浇水，形成并置反差。
interpretation_2_en: "Dry" also means lacking moisture, which contrasts with the topic of watering plants.
context: A gardener is giving a lecture about watering plants, and the description "dry" contrasts with that topic.
literal_translation: 园丁做了一场关于浇水的干巴巴的讲座，这在两个方向上都令人印象深刻。
functional_equivalence_translation: 园丁讲浇水，内容却很“干”，可谓双重贴切。
explanatory_translation: 园丁做了一场关于浇水的讲座，说它很“dry”既可指讲得枯燥乏味，也可与“watering（浇水、湿润）”形成字面上的干湿对照，所以有双关效果。
interpretation_1: The lecture was dull or not lively.
interpretation_2: The lecture was literally dry in contrast to the topic of watering, creating an ironic opposition.

surface_text: I'd like to be a Chinese laborer , said Tom coolly .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上，Tom 冷静地说他想当一名中国劳工。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, Tom calmly said that he would like to be a Chinese laborer.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含上，"coolly" 用来呼应中国劳工常被联想到的“苦力”发音，形成近音双关，暗示他说的是想当“苦力”。
interpretation_2_en: At a deeper level, "coolly" cues a sound-based pun with the word associated with Chinese laborers, echoing "coolie," an old term for a Chinese laborer.
context: 句中先说想当 Chinese laborer，后面的 coolly 与 coolie 近音，触发双关。
literal_translation: “我想当一名中国苦力，”汤姆冷静地说。
functional_equivalence_translation: “我想当个中国苦力，”汤姆‘苦力/冷静地’说道。
explanatory_translation: “我想当一名中国苦力，”汤姆冷静地说。这里 coolly 表面上是“冷静地”，同时借与 coolie（苦力，旧称）近音形成双关。
interpretation_1: Tom said it in a calm, unemotional manner.
interpretation_2: The wording hints at 'coolie', meaning a Chinese laborer.

surface_text: The psychiatrist told the genie his emotions were all bottled up .
interpretation_1_zh: 表层上是说这个精灵的情绪像被装进瓶子里一样，被困在瓶中。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the genie's emotions were literally bottled up, as if trapped inside a bottle.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是固定表达“bottled up emotions”，意思是他长期压抑、憋着自己的情绪，没有表达出来。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is the idiom 'bottled up emotions,' meaning he has been repressing or holding in his feelings instead of expressing them.
context: A psychiatrist is speaking to a genie, a being stereotypically confined in a bottle; the phrase describes emotions.
literal_translation: 精神科医生告诉精灵，他的情绪都被瓶装起来了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 精神科医生对精灵说，他的情绪一直都“憋在瓶里”。
explanatory_translation: 精神科医生对精灵说，他的情绪一直被压抑着；这里利用了 bottled up 既可表示“情绪压抑”，又呼应精灵住在瓶子里的设定。
interpretation_1: The genie's emotions were repressed and not expressed.
interpretation_2: Because he is a genie, his emotions are literally associated with being inside a bottle.

surface_text: The programmer prefers clean lines, on the screen and in the laundry basket.
interpretation_1_zh: 程序员喜欢简洁干净的代码行。
interpretation_1_en: The programmer prefers neat, readable lines of code on the screen.
interpretation_2_zh: 程序员也喜欢衣物线条整洁、没有脏污的衣服。
interpretation_2_en: The programmer also likes clothing that is clean and tidy in everyday life.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 这个程序员喜欢干净的线条，既在屏幕上，也在洗衣篮里。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这个程序员喜欢“干净的线”——屏幕上的代码行要清爽，洗衣篮里的衣物也要干净。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 clean lines 一方面指屏幕上简洁利落的代码/视觉线条，另一方面借 laundry basket 的语境转指干净的衣物，形成并置双关。
interpretation_1: neat, uncluttered lines in code or on a screen
interpretation_2: clean clothing items or lines of laundry in the laundry basket context

surface_text: Acupuncture : a jab well done .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是说，针灸就是一次做得很好的“扎一下”或“刺一下”。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means acupuncture is a jab or poke that is well done.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是在戏仿固定说法“a job well done”，把 job 换成近音的 jab，既呼应针灸用针刺的动作，也表达“这事做得漂亮”。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a play on the fixed phrase "a job well done": "job" is replaced with the similar-sounding "jab," which refers to the needle poke in acupuncture while also implying that it is done successfully.
context: Acupuncture is being described with a praise formula that is modified to include the idea of a needle jab.
literal_translation: 针灸：一次完成得很好的刺戳。
functional_equivalence_translation: 针灸：真是“针”得漂亮。
explanatory_translation: 这里把固定说法 'a job well done'（干得漂亮）中的 job 换成了 jab（戳、扎），借针灸用针刺的特点形成双关，意思是“针灸做得很漂亮”。
interpretation_1: a successful or skillfully performed act of acupuncture
interpretation_2: a playful alteration of the idiom 'a job well done' by replacing 'job' with 'jab' to evoke needle pricks

surface_text: To many girls the word'marriage'has a nice ring to it .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，对很多女孩来说，“marriage”这个词听起来很悦耳、很动听。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that to many girls, the word “marriage” sounds pleasant or appealing.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是“ring”也指婚戒，因此这句话暗示很多女孩喜欢“marriage”，也因为它让人联想到结婚戒指。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that “ring” also refers to a wedding ring, so the sentence suggests that many girls like the idea of “marriage” partly because it evokes the image of a marriage ring.
context: The phrase 'has a nice ring to it' is used together with 'marriage', which also evokes the idea of a wedding ring.
literal_translation: 对很多女孩来说，“婚姻”这个词听起来很美好。
functional_equivalence_translation: 对很多女孩来说，“婚姻”这个词既顺耳，又让人想到戒指。
explanatory_translation: 对很多女孩来说，“婚姻”这个词很动听；这里的 ring 一方面指“听起来悦耳”，另一方面又暗指“婚戒”。
interpretation_1: The word 'marriage' sounds pleasing or attractive.
interpretation_2: Marriage is associated with an actual ring, especially a wedding ring.

surface_text: I'll tempt Adam tonight , she said evilly .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上，她阴险地说今晚要去诱惑一个名叫亚当的人。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, she says wickedly that she will tempt a man named Adam tonight.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是影射《圣经》中夏娃诱惑亚当犯罪的典故，因此这句话把眼前的勾引行为和伊甸园中的“诱惑亚当”联系在一起。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is an allusion to the biblical story of Eve tempting Adam into sin, linking her intended seduction to the archetypal temptation of Adam in Eden.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话者以邪恶口吻说自己今晚要“tempt Adam”，其中 Adam 可被理解为普通人名，也可激活圣经中的亚当典故。
negative_example: I'll tempt John tonight, she said evilly.
literal_translation: “我今晚要诱惑亚当，”她邪恶地说道。
functional_equivalence_translation: “今晚我要去诱惑‘亚当’了，”她阴险地说。
explanatory_translation: “我今晚要去诱惑亚当，”她邪恶地说道。这里的 Adam 不仅可作人名，也让人想到《圣经》中的亚当，因此形成“诱惑某个叫 Adam 的人”与“重演诱惑亚当的典故”的双重含义。
interpretation_1: 她今晚要去诱惑名叫 Adam 的人。
interpretation_2: 借 Adam 指向《圣经》中亚当被诱惑的典故，暗示她要扮演诱惑者并制造“原罪式”的诱惑。

surface_text: Upon being shown a uniquely sculptured piece of so - called granite , a geologist remarked to his colleague " You know that's really gneiss . "
interpretation_1_zh: 地质学家是在说那块所谓的花岗岩其实是“片麻岩（gneiss）”，指出它真正的岩石种类。
interpretation_1_en: The geologist is saying that the so-called granite is actually gneiss, identifying its true rock type.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时，"gneiss" 与 "nice" 同音，话里也有“那东西真不错、真好看”的意思，是在借岩石名称顺带夸赞它。
interpretation_2_en: At the same time, "gneiss" sounds like "nice," so it also means “that’s really nice,” letting him compliment the piece while naming the rock.
context: A geologist is shown a sculptured rock described as granite and comments on it.
literal_translation: 你知道那其实真是片麻岩。
functional_equivalence_translation: 你知道，那块石头真是“片麻”又真“棒”。
explanatory_translation: 地质学家说“that's really gneiss”，表面像是在说“that's really nice（那真不错）”，同时又指出这块所谓的花岗岩其实是 gneiss（片麻岩）。
interpretation_1: The geologist means the sculptured piece is really nice.
interpretation_2: The geologist also means the rock is actually gneiss rather than granite.

surface_text: The mechanic values a smooth ride, both after the engine tune-up and during difficult conversations home.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是说修车工重视车辆调校后开起来是否平稳。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the mechanic cares about a car driving smoothly after service.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是说 smooth ride 也暗指人与人相处、谈话过程是否顺利不颠簸。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that a 'smooth ride' also suggests an interaction or conversation going without friction.
context: The phrase is applied both to a repaired car and to difficult conversations at home.
literal_translation: 这位机械师看重“平稳的行驶”，无论是在发动机调校之后，还是在家中进行艰难谈话时。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位机械师讲究一切都要“顺顺当当”，不管是修完车上路，还是回家谈难题。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 smooth ride 一方面指发动机调校后车辆行驶平稳，另一方面借指家里的艰难谈话也能顺利、少冲突地进行。
interpretation_1: A car that runs comfortably and steadily after a tune-up.
interpretation_2: A conversation or domestic interaction that proceeds without conflict.

surface_text: The storm chaser gave a surprisingly rainsoned answer.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是追风暴的人给出了一个深思熟虑的回答。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the storm chaser gave a thoughtful, reasoned answer.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把 reasoned 改成 rainsoned，嵌入 rain，强调回答与天气背景相关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning reshapes reasoned into rainsoned, inserting rain to tie the answer to stormy weather.
context: storm chaser 的身份使 rain 与 reasoned 的混成词成立；根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 那个追风暴的人给出了一个出人意料地“雨由充分”的回答。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位追风暴的人给出了一个格外“雨理俱全”的回答。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 reasoned（有理有据的）和 rain/rain-seasoned（被雨、风暴经历塑造的）混合成 rainsoned，既表示回答很有条理，也暗示说话者因长期追逐风暴而带着“雨感”思维。
interpretation_1: He gave a sensible, well-reasoned answer.
interpretation_2: As a storm chaser, his answer is figuratively shaped or seasoned by rain and storm experience.

surface_text: The weather app said a light shower was coming, so I packed both an umbrella and a dim lamp.
interpretation_1_zh: 天气应用说将有一阵小雨，意思是雨势不大。
interpretation_1_en: The app meant a shower with low intensity was coming.
interpretation_2_zh: “light”也可表示“光”，所以我除了带伞，还带了一盏不太亮的灯。
interpretation_2_en: “Light” also means illumination, so a lamp is packed along with the umbrella.
context: 天气预报说即将有一场 light shower，说话人因此同时带了雨伞和一盏暗灯。
literal_translation: 天气应用说一场小阵雨要来了，所以我同时带了一把伞和一盏昏暗的灯。
functional_equivalence_translation: 天气应用说有一场“light” shower要来，我就既带了伞，也带了灯。
explanatory_translation: 天气应用说有一场小阵雨要来；这里的 light 本来是指“雨小”，但说话人又把它理解成“光亮、照明”，所以还带上了一盏灯。
interpretation_1: Light means gentle or not heavy, so a light shower is a small amount of rain.
interpretation_2: Light is understood as illumination, which motivates packing a dim lamp.

surface_text: My name is Clarence , I specialize in end - of - season inventory closeout sales .
interpretation_1_zh: 说话人表面上是在做自我介绍：他叫 Clarence，专门做季末库存清仓甩卖。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the speaker is simply introducing himself: his name is Clarence, and he specializes in end-of-season inventory closeout sales.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是名字 Clarence 与 clear ance/clearance 构成谐音关联，暗示他本人就和“clearance（清仓甩卖）”这个词绑定在一起，形成名字与职业内容的双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the name Clarence echoes clearance, suggesting a pun that ties his very name to the idea of clearance sales.
context: 姓名介绍与“end-of-season inventory closeout sales”并置，激活 Clarence/clearance 的近音联想。
negative_example: My name is Lawrence, I specialize in end-of-season inventory closeout sales.
literal_translation: 我叫克拉伦斯，我专做季末库存清仓甩卖。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我叫“克拉伦斯”，专门做“清仓”甩卖生意。
explanatory_translation: 这里把人名 Clarence 说出来，让人联想到近音词 clearance（清仓甩卖），所以既像是在自我介绍，也是在点出他的行业。
interpretation_1: 说话者自称名字叫 Clarence。
interpretation_2: 暗指他做的是 clearance sales，即清仓甩卖。

surface_text: The seafood restaurant wanted more fresh staff, so they hired quicker servers and opened the windows.
interpretation_1_zh: “fresh staff”可理解为更有活力、更机灵的员工。
interpretation_1_en: "Fresh staff" can mean energetic, lively employees.
interpretation_2_zh: “fresh”也让人想到新鲜空气，于是开窗通风成了另一层呼应。
interpretation_2_en: "Fresh" also evokes freshness in the air, which is why opening the windows fits too.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：一家海鲜餐馆说想要更多“fresh”，随后一方面雇了更快的服务员，另一方面打开窗户。
negative_example: The seafood restaurant wanted more experienced staff, so they hired quicker servers and opened the windows.
literal_translation: 这家海鲜餐馆想要更多新鲜的员工，所以他们雇了更快的服务员，并打开了窗户。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家海鲜餐馆想要员工更“新鲜”一点，于是既招了手脚更麻利的服务员，也把窗户打开通风。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 fresh 构成双关：表面上是说“fresh staff”指更有活力或新来的员工；同时又激活“fresh air”的意思，因此“打开窗户”也成了合理回应。
interpretation_1: The restaurant wanted energetic or newly hired staff.
interpretation_2: The restaurant wanted the place to have fresher air, so they opened the windows.

surface_text: My piano tuner speaks in tiny adjustaments.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是，我的钢琴调音师总是用一种像“微调格言”般的话说话。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, my piano tuner seems to communicate in small, carefully phrased 'adjusta-ments.'
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是把 adjustment 和 testament / ament 式尾音混合，强调他的每次调音都带点郑重其事、像宣言一样。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden reading reshapes 'adjustments' into a more solemn-sounding hybrid, implying each tuning tweak is delivered like a tiny pronouncement.
context: A piano tuner is being described as speaking in a way related to tuning and making fine adjustments.
literal_translation: 我的钢琴调音师说话像一连串微小的“调节语”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我的钢琴调音师说话全是些细细碎碎的“调音词儿”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 adjustments（调节、微调）故意改成 adjustaments，借由拼写和发音上的接近制造文字游戏，既让人想到调音时的细微调整，也营造出他说话总在做小修小改的感觉。
interpretation_1: The piano tuner speaks in small adjustments or fine-tuning terms.
interpretation_2: The invented word echoes 'aments', suggesting tiny utterances made while adjusting the piano.

surface_text: My coding coach said the project needed more polish, so I refactored the interface and stopped wearing sneakers to stand-up.
interpretation_1_zh: 教练说项目需要更“精致/更完善”，所以我优化了界面。
interpretation_1_en: The coach meant polish as refinement, so I improved the interface.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时 polish 也让人联想到“擦亮、打扮得体”，所以我开会时不再穿运动鞋。
interpretation_2_en: Polish also suggests being well-groomed or shiny, so I dressed more formally for stand-up.
context: A coding coach says the project needs more polish; the speaker interprets this both as improving the interface and as changing appearance for stand-up.
negative_example: The project needed more style, so I refactored the interface and wore nicer shoes.
literal_translation: 我的编程教练说这个项目需要更多“polish”，所以我重构了界面，并且在站会时不再穿运动鞋了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我的编程教练说项目还得再“润色”一下，于是我一边重构界面，一边连站会穿着都变得更讲究了。
explanatory_translation: 我的编程教练说项目需要更多 polish，表层意思是“再精致些、再润色些”，同时又借 Polish（波兰的）形成双关，所以后半句故意把它理解成连外表打扮都要更正式。
interpretation_1: make the project more refined and professional
interpretation_2: make it more Polish, humorously extended to dressing formally instead of wearing sneakers

surface_text: A photographer taking pictures of golfers says 'watch the birdie'.
The storm chaser packed snacks, maps, and a lot of thunderplanning.
interpretation_1_zh: 追风暴的人做了很多周密计划，带好了零食和地图。
interpretation_1_en: The storm chaser did a lot of careful planning and preparation.
interpretation_2_zh: 新词把 thunder 加到 planning 前面，强调这些计划是围绕雷暴天气展开的。
interpretation_2_en: The blend adds 'thunder' to 'planning,' making the preparation specifically storm-related.
context: storm chaser packed snacks, maps, and planning for chasing storms
literal_translation: 那个追风暴的人打包了零食、地图，还有一大堆“雷声式规划”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个追风暴的人带上了零食、地图，还有一大堆“雷里雷气的计划”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 thunderplanning 混合了 underplanning 和 thunder planning：表面像在说与雷暴有关的规划，隐含又让人联想到 underplanning（规划不足）。
interpretation_1: insufficient or poor planning
interpretation_2: planning related to thunder and storm chasing

surface_text: Two snakes parted , and one said ,'fangs for the memories'.
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上看，这条蛇在分别时说“感谢这些回忆”，但把 thanks 说成了与蛇牙相关的 fangs。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the snake is saying “thanks for the memories” while replacing “thanks” with “fangs,” a word associated with snakes’ teeth.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借用固定表达“thanks for the memories”制造谐音双关，因为 fangs 与 thanks 发音相近，又呼应了蛇有毒牙这一特征。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a pun on the fixed phrase “thanks for the memories”: “fangs” sounds like “thanks,” and it also fits the fact that snakes have fangs.
context: Two snakes are parting and one delivers a farewell line; according to the surface text, this is the minimal necessary context recoverable.
literal_translation: 两条蛇分别时，一条说：‘獠牙感谢这些回忆。’
functional_equivalence_translation: 两条蛇告别时，一条说：‘牙谢这些回忆。’
explanatory_translation: 两条蛇告别时，一条把“thanks for the memories”故意说成“fangs for the memories”，因为“fangs”与“thanks”近音，同时“fangs”又指蛇的毒牙。
interpretation_1: The snake says a farewell phrase sounding like 'thanks for the memories'.
interpretation_2: Because the speaker is a snake, 'thanks' is replaced by 'fangs', referring to snake teeth.

surface_text: OLD CRICKETERS never die , they just get bowled over .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说老板球运动员不会死，他们只是被球投倒了、被击翻了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that old cricketers never die; they just get knocked over by a bowled ball.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是利用短语 bowled over 的常见意思“惊呆了、深受打动了”，同时又呼应板球里的 bowl，形成板球语境中的双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is the idiomatic sense of "bowled over," meaning greatly impressed or overwhelmed, while also echoing the cricket verb "bowl," creating a cricket-themed pun.
context: old cricketers；根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 老板球运动员永远不会死，他们只是被“投球击倒”了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老板球手从不真正离去，他们只是被一球“放倒”了。
explanatory_translation: 老板球运动员不会死，他们只是“bowled over”了：表面上指被深深打动或震住，暗中又借 cricket 里的 bowled 指被投球击中三柱而出局。
interpretation_1: They are greatly impressed or overwhelmed.
interpretation_2: In cricket, they are dismissed by being bowled out.

surface_text: Doctor , Doctor My little boy has just swallowed a roll of film ! - Hmmmm . Let's hope nothing develops . Next .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上医生是说，希望孩子吞下去的那卷胶卷在肚子里不要被“冲洗显影”出来。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the doctor means he hopes the roll of film does not 'develop' inside the boy, as in photographic film being processed.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是医生也在说，希望这件事不要进一步恶化，不要发展成严重的身体问题或症状。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that he hopes the situation does not develop into a serious medical problem or complication.
context: A doctor is told that a boy has swallowed a roll of film, so the word "develops" can refer both to a medical condition developing and photographic film being developed.
literal_translation: 医生，医生，我的小男孩刚吞下一卷胶卷！——嗯，希望什么都别发展起来。下一个。
functional_equivalence_translation: 医生，医生，我的小男孩刚吞下一卷胶卷！——嗯，希望别出“显影”情况。下一个。
explanatory_translation: 医生听说孩子吞了胶卷后说“希望 nothing develops”，表层是“希望别出问题/别恶化”，同时又借用 develop 在摄影中“显影胶卷”的意思，形成双关。
interpretation_1: Let’s hope nothing bad happens or no medical problem arises.
interpretation_2: Let’s hope the swallowed film does not get chemically developed like photographic film.

surface_text: My sleep-deprived lab partner submitted the report with pure yawnalysis.
interpretation_1_zh: 他提交的是一份分析报告。
interpretation_1_en: He submitted an analytical report.
interpretation_2_zh: 但他困得直打哈欠，这份分析也像是“哈欠式分析”。
interpretation_2_en: He was so tired that the analysis felt powered by yawns.
context: A sleep-deprived lab partner submitted a report.
literal_translation: 我那位睡眠不足的实验搭档提交了一份充满纯粹“哈欠分析”的报告。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我那位困到不行的实验搭档交上来的报告，简直是一篇“哈欠式分析”。
explanatory_translation: 我那位睡眠不足的实验搭档提交了报告；这里把 analysis 改成 yawnalysis，混合了 yawn（打哈欠）和 analysis（分析），意思是这份分析带着强烈的困倦感。
interpretation_1: The report was submitted as an analysis.
interpretation_2: The analysis is characterized by yawning or extreme sleepiness, implying tired and low-energy work.

surface_text: The chef values a strong finish, in the sauce and in the marathon.
hidden_form: finish in the sauce / finish in the marathon
interpretation_1_zh: 厨师重视酱汁收尾时的味道和质感。
interpretation_1_en: The chef cares about the final taste and texture of the sauce.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时也指在马拉松中有力地完成终点。
interpretation_2_en: It also means ending a marathon strongly with stamina.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：同一短语“strong finish”同时用于烹饪中的酱汁收尾效果和马拉松中的冲刺收官。
literal_translation: 这位厨师看重有力的收尾，不管是在酱汁里还是在马拉松中。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位厨师讲究“收得漂亮”——做酱汁要收尾够劲，跑马拉松也要冲刺够强。
explanatory_translation: 这里把“strong finish”并列用于两个领域：在烹饪里指酱汁最后呈现出的浓郁有力的收尾效果，在马拉松里指最后阶段强劲的冲刺表现。
interpretation_1: A rich, impactful ending in a sauce's flavor.
interpretation_2: A powerful final stage or sprint at the end of a marathon.

surface_text: Long fairy tales have a tendency to dragon .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说，长篇童话故事有一种“像龙一样”的倾向，把 dragon 当成和 fairy tales 相关的字面词来制造荒诞效果。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that long fairy tales have a tendency to 'dragon,' using dragon literally in a fairy-tale context for a nonsensical effect.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把 dragon 用来谐拟 dragging，意思是长篇童话往往会拖得很长、节奏拖沓。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that dragon plays on dragging, suggesting that long fairy tales tend to drag on and become lengthy or tedious.
context: fairy tales; long stories; 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 长篇童话故事往往会“龙”。
functional_equivalence_translation: Long fairy tales tend to drag on—quite literally, with dragons.
explanatory_translation: 这个双关把短语 'drag on'（拖沓、没完没了）写成了同音的 'dragon'（龙）；因为语境是 fairy tales，所以“龙”的意象也被激活。
interpretation_1: Long fairy tales tend to drag on, meaning they continue tediously for too long.
interpretation_2: In a fairy-tale context, 'dragon' evokes the creature commonly appearing in such stories.

surface_text: Our violin coach insists on proper bow control, both in rehearsal and at formal dinners.
interpretation_1_zh: 小提琴教练强调要控制好琴弓的使用。
interpretation_1_en: The violin coach insists on controlling the bow properly during playing.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时 bow 也可指鞠躬，所以在正式晚宴上也要控制好自己的礼节动作。
interpretation_2_en: Bow also means to bend politely, so proper bow control applies at formal dinners too.
context: violin coach, proper bow control, rehearsal, formal dinners
literal_translation: 我们的小提琴教练坚持要掌握好 bow 的控制，无论是在排练中还是在正式晚宴上。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们的小提琴教练强调要练好“弓”功，连正式晚宴上的“鞠躬”分寸也不能失控。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 bow 一语双关：在排练中指小提琴的琴弓，在正式晚宴中则指鞠躬致意。
interpretation_1: 在小提琴演奏中控制琴弓的使用
interpretation_2: 在正式晚宴上控制鞠躬致意的礼仪动作

surface_text: Acrobats are always doing good turns.
Two companies that made shoelaces had common ties .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是，这两家生产鞋带的公司有共同的联系或共同点。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the two companies that made shoelaces had something in common or were connected.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是“ties”也可以指带子、系带之类的东西，所以它巧妙呼应了这些公司生产的鞋带。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that "ties" can also refer to things used for tying, which playfully echoes the shoelaces made by the companies.
context: 两家公司都生产鞋带，因此 ties 既可指共同关系，也可联想到鞋带/系带
negative_example: Two companies that made shoelaces had common strings.
literal_translation: 两家制作鞋带的公司有共同的联系。
functional_equivalence_translation: 两家做鞋带的公司真是“系”出同门。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 ties 一方面表示“联系、关系”，另一方面又让人想到“系带、鞋带”，因为前文说的是制作 shoelaces 的公司。
interpretation_1: connections or relationships in common
interpretation_2: shoe ties, referring to shoelaces made by the companies

surface_text: " How long will I have to wait for a table ? " asked Tom without reservation .
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是：汤姆毫无保留、直截了当地问：“我还要等多久才有桌位？”
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means Tom asked directly and without hesitation, "How long will I have to wait for a table?"
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是：汤姆是在没有预订餐位的情况下发问；这里的 reservation 既可指“保留、顾虑”，也可指“预订”。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that Tom was asking without having a table reservation; "reservation" can mean both hesitation/restraint and a booking.
context: 在餐馆等位、询问 table 的语境中，reservation 既可理解为“保留意见/犹豫”，也可理解为“预订”。
literal_translation: “我还要等多久才有桌位？”汤姆毫无保留地问道。
functional_equivalence_translation: “我还要等多久才有位子？”汤姆问道，他可没有预订。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 without reservation 双关：表面上是“毫无保留地/坦率地”，在餐馆语境里又可理解为“没有预订”。
interpretation_1: Tom asked confidently or plainly, with no hesitation.
interpretation_2: Tom asked because he did not have a restaurant reservation.

surface_text: The detective described the bakery case as cruminally intriguing.
interpretation_1_zh: 侦探说这起面包店案件离奇得简直像犯罪小说一样吸引人。
interpretation_1_en: The detective said the bakery case was criminally intriguing.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个词把 crumb 混进 criminally，暗示案件线索和面包屑、糕点碎屑有关。
interpretation_2_en: The blend inserts crumb, hinting that the case involves bakery crumbs as clues.
context: 侦探在描述一个与面包店有关的案件时，使用了 cruminally 这个混成词。
literal_translation: 那位侦探把这起面包店案件描述为“面包屑般地犯罪式地引人入胜”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位侦探说这起面包店案子真是“屑罪般”耐人寻味。
explanatory_translation: 侦探把 criminally intriguing 改成了 cruminally intriguing，把 criminally（带有“犯罪地”之意）和 crumb（面包屑）的联想混在一起，既说明是案件，又点出面包店背景。
interpretation_1: The detective says the bakery case is criminally intriguing, meaning it strongly concerns crime.
interpretation_2: The altered word also evokes crumbs and baked goods, linking the case to a bakery.

surface_text: The wildlife vet praised the owl for its remarkable hootility.
interpretation_1_zh: 野生动物兽医称赞这只猫头鹰非常有用、很能派上用场。
interpretation_1_en: The wildlife veterinarian praises the owl for being highly useful or effective.
interpretation_2_zh: 该词把猫头鹰的叫声“hoot”和“utility”拼在一起，形成带动物特征的新词。
interpretation_2_en: The coined term blends the owl's 'hoot' with 'utility,' giving usefulness an owl-specific twist.
context: A wildlife vet is praising an owl, which activates the owl sound “hoot” and makes the blended word interpretable.
literal_translation: 野生动物兽医称赞这只猫头鹰有非凡的“咕用性”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 野生动物兽医夸这只猫头鹰真是“咕咕有用”。
explanatory_translation: 野生动物兽医称赞这只猫头鹰非常出色；这里把 owl 的叫声 hoot 和 utility 拼合成 hootility，形成双关。
interpretation_1: A playful noun meaning usefulness or practical value.
interpretation_2: The owl is being praised through a blend that links its owl-like hoot with utility, suggesting its remarkable value as an owl.

surface_text: The drama club's budget meeting turned theatrical when the treasurer announced fiscalrama.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是，财务问题引发了一场戏剧化的预算会议。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the budget meeting became dramatic because of financial issues.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是，在戏剧社里，财政风波本身就像一出情节夸张的舞台剧。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the financial dispute itself became a melodramatic performance, fitting for a drama club.
context: A drama club is holding a budget meeting, and the treasurer makes a financial announcement that is described in theatrical terms.
literal_translation: 戏剧社的预算会议变得很有戏剧性，因为司库宣布了“财政戏码”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 戏剧社一开预算会就演上了，司库一宣布预算，现场直接成了“财务大戏”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 fiscalrama 是仿造词，把 fiscal（财政的）和 drama（戏剧）拼在一起，意思是这场预算会议因财务问题而变成了一出戏。
interpretation_1: The budget meeting became a dramatic dispute about finances.
interpretation_2: The coined word blends finance-related 'fiscal' with 'drama,' framing the treasurer's announcement as theatrical.

surface_text: Our apartment meeting became rentimental as soon as the lease was mentioned.
interpretation_1_zh: 一提到租约，室友会议立刻变得情绪化、感伤起来。
interpretation_1_en: As soon as the lease came up, the apartment meeting became emotional and sentimental.
interpretation_2_zh: rentimental 把 rent 和 sentimental 拼在一起，表示与房租相关的情绪化反应。
interpretation_2_en: Rentimental blends rent and sentimental, suggesting emotions specifically triggered by rent or lease issues.
context: Apartment meeting; discussion turns to the lease and rent-related matters.
literal_translation: 一提到租约，我们的公寓会议就变得“租情化”了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 一提到租约，我们的公寓会议立刻变得既伤感又满是房租味了。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 sentimental（伤感的、情绪化的）和 rent（房租）拼成了 rentimental，表示会议一提到租约就变得情绪化，而这种情绪又和房租问题有关。
interpretation_1: The meeting became emotional.
interpretation_2: The emotion was specifically triggered by talk about rent or the lease.

surface_text: A six foot poet stanza very tall.
The poet-barista served a heartbreakingly brewtiful sonnet.
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是在夸这首十四行诗非常优美动人。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it praises the sonnet as beautiful and moving.
interpretation_2_zh: brew 指冲煮咖啡，说明这位诗人同时也是咖啡师，诗和咖啡被融合在一起。
interpretation_2_en: Brew points to coffee-making, blending the poet's literary side with the barista setting.
context: poet-barista; served a sonnet
literal_translation: 那位诗人咖啡师端上了一首令人心碎地“冲泡般美丽”的十四行诗。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位诗人咖啡师奉上了一首令人心碎的“啡常美”的十四行诗。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 brewtiful 是 beautiful 和 brew 的混成词，表面上说这首十四行诗很美，隐含上又呼应了说话者是咖啡师、与冲泡咖啡有关。
interpretation_1: The sonnet is described as beautiful.
interpretation_2: The description also evokes coffee brewing, fitting a barista-poet.

surface_text: Modern fashion designs are often presented with tongue in chic .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上这句话说，现代时装设计常常以一种很时髦、很有风格的方式被呈现出来。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the sentence says that modern fashion designs are often presented in a very chic, stylish way.
interpretation_2_zh: 这里把固定表达“tongue in cheek”改成了“tongue in chic”，借“chic”与“cheek”的近音形成双关，暗示这些设计不仅时尚，还带有一种戏谑、讽刺、故意不太严肃的意味。
interpretation_2_en: The phrase plays on the idiom "tongue in cheek" by replacing "cheek" with the near-sounding word "chic." It suggests that the designs are not only fashionable but also presented with irony, wit, or playful insincerity.
context: Fashion designs are being discussed, so 'tongue in cheek' is altered to fit a style-related context.
literal_translation: 现代时装设计常常以“舌头在时髦里”的方式呈现。
functional_equivalence_translation: 现代时装设计常常带着一种“戏谑又时髦”的味道亮相。
explanatory_translation: 这里把固定说法 'tongue in cheek'（带着戏谑、反讽意味）中的 cheek 换成了与时尚相关的 chic，形成与服装设计语境呼应的双关。
interpretation_1: The phrase echoes the idiom 'tongue in cheek,' meaning ironic or playful.
interpretation_2: Replacing 'cheek' with 'chic' links the phrase to fashion and stylishness.

surface_text: The dentist called my late cancellation an appointmental issue.
interpretation_1_zh: 牙医说我临时取消预约是一个预约安排上的问题。
interpretation_1_en: The dentist said my late cancellation was an issue related to the appointment.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个词也把 mental 融进去，暗示我对看牙这件事心理上有障碍或焦虑。
interpretation_2_en: The blend also hints that the problem is partly mental: I am psychologically avoiding the dentist.
context: A dentist comments on someone's late cancellation and labels it an 'appointmental issue.'
literal_translation: 牙医把我临时取消预约称为一个“预约心理”问题。
functional_equivalence_translation: 牙医说我临时取消预约，真是个“约有点疯”的问题。
explanatory_translation: 牙医把我临时取消预约说成“appointmental issue”，表面上像是“预约方面的问题”，同时谐拟了“a mental issue（精神/脑子有问题）”，用来调侃这次取消很离谱。
interpretation_1: The issue is about a dental appointment, specifically a late cancellation.
interpretation_2: It echoes 'a mental issue,' implying the cancellation was irrational or crazy-making.

surface_text: The tightrope walker gently took a step at a time and always wore diamond - laced slippers . The spectators always would stare in awe at the tightrope walker's feat .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说观众总会敬畏地注视这位走钢丝者完成的高超技艺和壮举。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the spectators watched in awe at the tightrope walker's impressive accomplishment or stunt.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把 feat 和 feet 联系起来，既指他的壮举，也暗示观众在惊叹地看他的脚，因为走钢丝和那双镶钻拖鞋都与脚有关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on feat and feet: it refers not only to his remarkable stunt but also suggests that the spectators were literally staring at his feet, which matters because he is tightrope walking and wearing diamond-laced slippers.
context: A tightrope walker takes careful steps and wears diamond-laced slippers, making both the performance and the feet salient.
literal_translation: 观众总会敬畏地盯着这位走钢丝者的壮举。
functional_equivalence_translation: 观众总会敬畏地盯着这位走钢丝者的绝技，也盯着他的双脚看。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 feat 表层是“壮举、绝技”，同时与 feet（双脚）同音；结合前文反复写他一步一步走、还穿着钻石系带拖鞋，暗示观众既在看他的表演，也在看他的脚。
interpretation_1: The spectators admire the tightrope walker's impressive accomplishment.
interpretation_2: The spectators are also staring at the tightrope walker's feet, highlighted by the diamond-laced slippers and careful stepping.

surface_text: I was going to buy a book on phobias , but I was afraid it wouldn't help me .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说，讲述者本来想买一本关于恐惧症的书，但他担心这本书对自己没有帮助，所以没有买。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the speaker was going to buy a book about phobias, but was worried that it would not help, so he did not buy it.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是，既然是关于恐惧症的书，他自己说“afraid”就形成了反讽：他本身就在表现出害怕，说明他可能正受恐惧症或过度恐惧心理影响。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that because the book is about phobias, saying he was 'afraid' becomes ironic: he is himself showing fear, suggesting that he may already be affected by phobia or excessive fear.
context: A speaker considers buying a self-help book about phobias but says they are afraid it would not help; 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 我本来打算买一本关于恐惧症的书，但我怕它帮不了我。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我本想买本治恐惧症的书，可一想到这事我自己就先害怕了，怕它没用。
explanatory_translation: 我本来想买一本关于恐惧症的书，但我说“我怕它帮不了我”时，既表示“担心没效果”，也呼应了“恐惧症/害怕”这个主题，形成语义双关。
interpretation_1: The speaker is worried that the book on phobias would not be useful.
interpretation_2: The speaker is themselves fearful, so their fear about phobias is enacted in the sentence.

surface_text: " It's my personal magnetism , " said Tom ironically .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：汤姆讽刺地说，那是他个人的磁力，仿佛他真的像磁铁一样会产生吸引力。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, Tom ironically says that it is his personal magnetism, as if he literally has magnetic force like a magnet.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：magnetism 也可指个人魅力或吸引他人的气质，所以他是在讽刺地说那是他自身的人格魅力在起作用。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that magnetism can also mean personal charm or charisma, so he is ironically suggesting that it is his own attractive personality at work.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话人用 ironicly 表明自己把“personal magnetism”同时理解为魅力和真正的磁力
literal_translation: “这是我个人的磁力，”汤姆讽刺地说。
functional_equivalence_translation: “这就是我的个人‘吸引力’，”汤姆讽刺地说。
explanatory_translation: “这就是我的个人吸引力，”汤姆讽刺地说；这里的 magnetism 既指人的魅力，也暗指真正的磁性。
interpretation_1: personal charm or charisma
interpretation_2: literal magnetic force that attracts metal

surface_text: A dog who played baseball always got walked.
The violin maker is known for fine strings and even finer strings of compliments.
interpretation_1_zh: 这位制琴师以优质琴弦闻名，而且还总是接连不断地夸人。
interpretation_1_en: The violin maker is known for excellent violin strings and for giving a long series of compliments.
interpretation_2_zh: “strings”既是乐器上的弦，也可指一连串的话语。
interpretation_2_en: 'Strings' refers both to instrument strings and to a sequence of words, as in a string of compliments.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：谈论一位小提琴制作者，先说他以优质琴弦闻名，又说他很会连珠炮似地说恭维话。
negative_example: The violin maker is known for fine wires and even finer compliments.
literal_translation: 这位小提琴制作师以精良的弦闻名，还以更高明的一连串恭维闻名。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位小提琴制作师不仅弦做得好，连甜言蜜语都是一套一套的。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 strings 一方面指小提琴的弦，另一方面指“一连串”的恭维话，因此形成并置双关。
interpretation_1: the cords on a violin
interpretation_2: a succession or flow of flattering remarks

surface_text: The sleep-deprived novelist called her draft a snoreline.
interpretation_1_zh: 她说自己的草稿像“故事线”一样有结构。
interpretation_1_en: She refers to the draft as having a storyline.
interpretation_2_zh: 她也暗示这份草稿无聊得让人想打呼。
interpretation_2_en: She also implies the draft is so boring it could make people snore.
context: A sleep-deprived novelist comments on her own draft and uses a modified version of “storyline” to suggest it is dull and sleep-inducing.
literal_translation: 那位睡眠不足的小说家把她的草稿称作一条“打鼾线”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位困得不行的小说家说她的草稿不是故事线，而是“催睡线”。
