surface_text: Our sleep-deprived copy editor relied on pure commaflage to hide the weak paragraph.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是：这位困倦的文字编辑靠一种“逗号式伪装”来掩饰薄弱的段落。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the tired copy editor used a kind of comma-based camouflage to hide a weak paragraph.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：编辑靠添加或摆弄标点，尤其是逗号，来让文段看起来更顺、更不容易暴露问题。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the editor used punctuation, especially commas, to make the paragraph seem stronger than it was.
context: A copy editor is working on a weak paragraph and tries to hide its flaws by adding or manipulating commas.
literal_translation: 我们那个睡眠不足的文字编辑依靠纯粹的“逗号伪装”来掩盖那段薄弱的段落。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们那位缺觉的文案编辑全靠“逗号障眼法”把那段写得很虚的文字遮过去了。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 commaflage 是把 comma 和 camouflage 拼合而成的双关，意思是编辑不是把段落改好，而是靠摆弄逗号来把问题伪装起来。
interpretation_1: A playful term suggesting the editor used commas as a way to conceal problems in the paragraph.
interpretation_2: It echoes 'camouflage', implying the weak writing was disguised rather than improved.

surface_text: A book called 'Current Trends in Wiring your House' turned out to be a shocking failure.
The saxophonist enjoys cool bars, in jazz clubs and summer weather.
interpretation_1_zh: 萨克斯手喜欢很酷的酒吧，尤其是爵士俱乐部。
interpretation_1_en: The saxophonist enjoys stylish or appealing bars, especially jazz clubs.
interpretation_2_zh: 萨克斯手也喜欢天气里的凉爽时段。
interpretation_2_en: The saxophonist also enjoys cool stretches of summer weather.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：'cool' simultaneously links to 'bars' in jazz clubs and to 'summer weather'.
negative_example: The saxophonist enjoys cold bars in jazz clubs and summer weather.
literal_translation: 这位萨克斯手喜欢很酷的酒吧，在爵士俱乐部里，也喜欢凉爽的夏日天气。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位萨克斯手既爱爵士俱乐部里的酷酒吧，也爱夏天的凉爽。
explanatory_translation: 这句话把 cool 同时挂到 bars 和 summer weather 上：前者指“很酷/时髦”，后者指“凉爽”，形成并置双关。
interpretation_1: The saxophonist likes stylish or trendy bars in jazz clubs.
interpretation_2: The saxophonist likes cool weather, with 'cool' applying to summer weather rather than bars.

surface_text: The baker wanted a warmer welcome, so I smiled at the customers and turned up the proofing room.
interpretation_1_zh: 面包师希望迎客时更热情，所以我对顾客笑得更亲切。
interpretation_1_en: The baker meant a friendlier welcome, so I smiled more at customers.
interpretation_2_zh: “warmer”也可指温度更高，所以我把醒发室的温度调高了。
interpretation_2_en: "Warmer" also means higher in temperature, so I turned up the proofing room.
context: 面包师想要更“温暖”的欢迎；说话者一方面对顾客微笑，另一方面把发酵室温度调高。
negative_example: The baker wanted a warmer oven, so I turned up the proofing room.
literal_translation: 面包师想要一个更温暖的欢迎，所以我对顾客微笑，并把发酵室的温度调高了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 面包师想要更“热情”的招待，于是我一边对顾客报以微笑，一边把发酵房真的调得更热了。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 warmer 同时理解为“更热情的”和“温度更高的”：前者通过微笑体现，后者通过调高发酵室温度体现。
interpretation_1: a friendlier and more enthusiastic reception for customers
interpretation_2: a literally hotter environment created by increasing the temperature in the proofing room

surface_text: They argued about their vacation and finally stayed at the last resort .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上，这句话是说他们争论假期安排后，最后住进了最后一家度假村或一家名叫“Last Resort”的度假地。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that after arguing about their vacation, they ended up staying at the last resort, i.e. the final resort available or a place called 'Last Resort.'
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借用了固定短语“last resort”的意思，即“不得已才采取的最后办法”。这里把“resort”既理解为“度假村”，又激活了“最后手段”的含义。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the idiom 'last resort,' which means a final option used only when nothing else works. Here, 'resort' refers both to a vacation resort and to a last desperate measure.
context: 一对人争论假期安排，最终决定住进某个度假村；短语“last resort”同时可按地点名词和惯用义理解。
literal_translation: 他们为假期争论不休，最后住在了最后的度假村。
functional_equivalence_translation: 他们为度假安排吵了半天，最后只好住进那家“最后的度假村”。
explanatory_translation: 他们为假期安排争论不休，最后住进了一家度假村；这里 last resort 既可字面理解为“最后选择的度假村”，也可理解为习语“最后手段/无奈之举”。
interpretation_1: 他们最后选择住在最后一家度假村。
interpretation_2: 他们是在别无选择的情况下才作出这个决定；last resort 也表示“最后手段”。

surface_text: The ailing king of the doves sensed an imminent coup .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：这位病重的鸽子国王察觉到一场即将发生的政变。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that the sick king of the doves sensed an imminent political overthrow.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是借“coup”与鸽子的叫声“coo”近音形成双关，暗示他听到了不寻常的鸽子咕咕叫声，仿佛预示着危险将至。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a pun on "coup" sounding like "coo," the sound doves make, suggesting that he sensed ominous cooing from the doves as a sign of trouble.
context: A king of the doves is described as ailing and sensing an imminent coup; the bird setting activates the sound-alike coo.
literal_translation: 那位生病的鸽子国王感觉到一场即将发生的政变。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位病中的鸽王察觉到一场即将到来的“咕变”。
explanatory_translation: 那位生病的鸽子国王感觉到一场即将发生的政变；这里的 coup（政变）又借与 coo（鸽子的咕咕叫）近音形成双关。
interpretation_1: The dove king sensed an imminent overthrow or rebellion.
interpretation_2: Because doves coo, the phrase also evokes an imminent coo by the doves.

surface_text: Any golfer will tell you the gospel truth . Your next shot always depends on the lie .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：高尔夫球手会告诉你一个真理——你的下一杆总是取决于球所处的位置和落点状况，也就是球的 lie。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that any golfer knows a basic truth: your next shot depends on the ball's lie, meaning the position or condition in which the ball is resting.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是利用 lie 也可表示“谎言”的意思，形成反差：前面说的是“福音般的真话”，后面却说下一杆取决于“谎言”，制造幽默双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the other sense of lie as 'a falsehood.' After mentioning 'the gospel truth,' the sentence humorously suggests that your next shot depends on 'the lie,' creating a contrast between truth and lies.
context: golf语境中谈论下一杆，同时前文有gospel truth触发truth/lie对立
literal_translation: 任何高尔夫球手都会告诉你绝对的真理：你的下一杆总取决于那个 lie。
functional_equivalence_translation: 任何高尔夫球手都会告诉你一句大实话：你的下一杆，总要看球 lie 得怎么样。
explanatory_translation: 任何高尔夫球手都会告诉你一个“真理”：你的下一杆取决于球的 lie——在高尔夫里指球所处的位置，而 lie 在普通英语里又有“谎言”之意，因此和前面的 truth 构成双关。
interpretation_1: in golf, the position or resting place of the ball
interpretation_2: a falsehood or untruth

surface_text: A restaurant owner gave his cooks a stirring speech.
A guy went to a costume party dressed as a knife, and he really looked sharp.
The violin repair shop offers restrings attached.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是，这家小提琴维修店提供重新装弦的服务。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the violin repair shop provides restringing services.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是，它戏仿 fixed phrase 'strings attached'，仿佛这些服务还自带某种附加条件。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning parodies 'strings attached,' suggesting both literal violin strings and figurative conditions.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：一家小提琴维修店在宣传其维修或换弦服务。
literal_translation: 这家小提琴维修店提供“附带重新上弦”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家小提琴维修店提供“弦外有弦”的服务。
explanatory_translation: 这句话把固定说法“no strings attached”改成“restrings attached”：表面上说维修店会给乐器重新装弦，隐含上借用了“strings attached”这个表达来制造双关。
interpretation_1: 指小提琴维修店提供重新上弦这一服务。
interpretation_2: 仿照固定表达“no strings attached”，形成关于“strings/琴弦”的双关。

surface_text: The barista prefers a long draw, from the espresso machine and from a storyteller.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是咖啡机萃取时拉出的液流时间较长。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means a longer pull from the espresso machine.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是讲故事的人也要有很强的吸引力，能把人带进去。
interpretation_2_en: It also means a storyteller should have a strong ability to draw people in.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：barista同时评价咖啡萃取过程和讲故事的风格，long draw分别对应浓缩咖啡的长萃取与故事讲述的拖长铺陈
literal_translation: 这位咖啡师喜欢长一点的draw，既来自意式咖啡机，也来自讲故事的人。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位咖啡师偏爱“拉得长”的东西：咖啡要长萃，故事也要娓娓道来。
explanatory_translation: 这里的draw一语双关：一方面指浓缩咖啡机的拉取/萃取时间较长，另一方面指讲故事时故意拖长、缓慢展开的叙述方式。
interpretation_1: a long pull or extraction of espresso from the machine
interpretation_2: a long, drawn-out manner of telling a story

surface_text: A baker stopped making donuts after he got tired of the hole thing.
The museum guard watched the dinosaur hall with fossility.
interpretation_1_zh: 博物馆保安在恐龙展厅里工作得很熟练、很从容。
interpretation_1_en: The museum guard watched the dinosaur hall with ease and professional facility.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个词又把“化石”带了进来，强调他守的是化石展区。
interpretation_2_en: The coinage also evokes fossils, underscoring that his expertise is in a fossil-filled dinosaur hall.
context: museum guard, dinosaur hall, fossils; 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 博物馆守卫以“化石般的熟练”看守着恐龙展厅。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位博物馆守卫看守恐龙馆时，显得格外“化练”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 facility（轻松、熟练）改成 fossility，借 fossil（化石）制造双关：既表示守卫看守得很熟练，又呼应恐龙展厅里的化石主题。
interpretation_1: The guard watched the dinosaur hall with ease or efficiency.
interpretation_2: The wording evokes fossils, fitting the dinosaur-hall setting.

surface_text: OLD CHEMISTS never die , they just lose their refluxes .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是老化学家不会死，他们只是失去了“回流”功能或装置，指化学实验中的回流现象。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says old chemists never die; they just lose their refluxes, referring to chemical reflux in laboratory work.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义影射了常见的老笑话说法“they just lose their reflexes”，意思是老人不是死去，而是反应能力、反射能力变差了；这里把 reflexes 改成了 chemists 相关的 refluxes 来制造双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning echoes the familiar joke formula 'they just lose their reflexes,' meaning old people become slow and lose their physical reflexes; here 'reflexes' is replaced with the chemistry-related 'refluxes' to create the pun.
context: 仿拟固定句式“Old X never die, they just lose their reflexes”，并将 reflexes 替换为化学相关的 refluxes。
literal_translation: 老化学家永远不会死，他们只是失去了回流。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老化学家不会死，他们只是没了“反应”也没了“回流”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把常见笑话里的 reflexes（反应能力）换成了与化学有关、发音相近的 refluxes（回流），形成双关。
interpretation_1: 老化学家不会死，只是失去了“反流”这一化学相关状态。
interpretation_2: 套用常见说法“old ... never die, they just lose their reflexes”，意思是老人只是失去反应能力。

surface_text: Ampere was worried he wasn't up to current research.
A city worker who campaigned for new sewer pipes finally had to go underground.
The bakery's emergency plan is basically croissantainment.
interpretation_1_zh: 这家面包店的应急方案本质上是某种控制和围堵措施。
interpretation_1_en: The bakery's emergency plan is basically a form of containment.
interpretation_2_zh: 把 croissant 拼进 containment 后，意思变成了“把牛角包控制住”或围绕牛角包展开的应对方案。
interpretation_2_en: By blending croissant with containment, it humorously suggests a crisis plan focused on managing runaway pastries.
context: bakery 与 emergency plan 共同触发对 croissant 和 containment 的双重联想。
literal_translation: 这家面包店的应急方案基本上就是“牛角面包式围控”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家面包店的应急预案，说白了就是“可颂管控”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 containment（控制、围堵）和 croissant（牛角面包/可颂）拼合成 croissantainment，表示面包店的应急方案被戏称为带有牛角面包特色的“围控方案”。
interpretation_1: 指面包店的应急方案是某种“控制、围堵”措施。
interpretation_2: 把 croissant 嵌入 containment，暗示这是面包店版本的围控方案，与牛角面包有关。

surface_text: The astronomer prefers clear observations, in the telescope and in meetings.
interpretation_1_zh: 天文学家喜欢清晰的观测结果，也就是通过望远镜看到的内容要清楚。
interpretation_1_en: The astronomer wants observations through the telescope to be visually clear and reliable.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时也指在会议上提出的观察和意见要表达明确、不含糊。
interpretation_2_en: It also means comments or remarks in meetings should be clear and precise.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：astronomer 一方面用望远镜做天文观测，另一方面也参加会议；observations 同时可指“观测结果/观察”与“意见评论”。
literal_translation: 这位天文学家喜欢清晰的观察，不管是在望远镜里还是在会议中。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位天文学家喜欢“清楚的观察”——望远镜里看得清，会议里说得也清。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 observations 构成双关：在望远镜语境中指天文观测/观测结果，在会议语境中指发言、评论或见解；clear 因而同时修饰“看得清”和“表达清楚”。
interpretation_1: clear views or sightings through a telescope
interpretation_2: clear, insightful remarks or observations made in meetings

surface_text: OLD FORESTERS never die , they just pine away .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说老林务员不会死，他们只是因思念或衰弱而日渐消瘦、憔悴下去。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says old foresters never die; they simply pine away, meaning they gradually waste away or become weak and thin.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义利用了 pine 既可表示“憔悴下去”，也可指“松树”的双关，呼应 foresters，暗示他们是像松树一样“变成松树般地消失”。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on pine, which means both “to waste away” and “pine tree,” fitting the forestry context and suggesting they fade away in a tree-related sense.
context: OLD FORESTERS never die, they just pine away.
literal_translation: 老林务员永远不会死，他们只是松树般地消逝。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老林务员不会死，只会“松”下去。
explanatory_translation: 老林务员不会死，他们只是渐渐衰弱下去；其中 pine away 本义是“憔悴、消瘦下去”，同时 pine 又让人联想到“松树”，与 foresters 的语境形成双关。
interpretation_1: Old foresters do not die; they merely waste away or decline.
interpretation_2: Because foresters are associated with forests and trees, "pine" also evokes the pine tree.

surface_text: I tried to record an album in a reptile shop , but there was a terrible gecko .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说我想在爬行动物商店里录制专辑，但店里有一只很吵或很糟糕的壁虎，影响了录音。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means I tried to record an album in a reptile shop, but there was a terrible gecko there that ruined the recording.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把“gecko”说成了与“echo”近音的词，真正想表达的是店里回声很严重，影响了录音效果。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a pun on "gecko" sounding like "echo": what is really meant is that there was a terrible echo in the shop, which interfered with the recording.
context: 在爬行动物商店里录专辑，地点会出现壁虎；录音场景又容易让人联想到 echo。
literal_translation: 我试着在一家爬行动物商店里录制一张专辑，但那里有一只糟糕的壁虎。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我想在爬宠店录专辑，结果“回”声太重——简直像来了只壁虎。
explanatory_translation: 我试着在一家爬行动物商店里录专辑，但那里有个可怕的“gecko”。这里用 gecko（壁虎）谐拟 echo（回声），既符合爬宠店语境，也暗示录音时回声很严重。
interpretation_1: There was an actual gecko in the reptile shop.
interpretation_2: There was a terrible echo that interfered with recording the album.

surface_text: When the waiter told me they were out of corn I said ,'That really shucks . '
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是“这真是去壳了/剥壳了”，呼应玉米需要剥壳这一层字面意思。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it refers to shucking corn, meaning removing the husk, which directly relates to corn.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把“shucks”当作感叹词，表示“真糟糕”“真遗憾”，意思是听到没有玉米让人很失望。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning uses “shucks” as an interjection meaning “that's too bad” or “what a shame,” expressing disappointment that they had no corn.
context: 顾客被服务员告知没有玉米可点，于是回应“That really shucks.”
literal_translation: 当服务员告诉我他们没有玉米时，我说：“那真是shucks。”
functional_equivalence_translation: 当服务员说没有玉米时，我说：“这可真够剥心的。”
explanatory_translation: 当服务员告诉我没有玉米时，我说：“这真让人失望。”这里的 shucks 既可表示“哎呀/真可惜”，又让人联想到“剥玉米壳”。
interpretation_1: An interjection meaning 'that's disappointing' or 'what a shame.'
interpretation_2: A reference to shucking corn, activated because the restaurant has no corn.

surface_text: OLD MATHEMATICIANS never die , they just go off on a tangent
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说老数学家不会死，他们只是转到“切线”上去了，像是在用几何里的 tangent 这个数学概念开玩笑。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says old mathematicians never die; they just go off on a tangent, using the mathematical meaning of 'tangent' as a geometric term.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借用固定说法“go off on a tangent”，表示人说话或思路突然离题、转向别处；这里把数学术语和日常表达叠加起来形成双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning relies on the idiom 'go off on a tangent,' which means to digress or suddenly move off topic; the joke combines that everyday expression with the mathematical term.
context: The sentence is about mathematicians and uses the idiom "go off on a tangent."
literal_translation: 老数学家永远不会死，他们只是偏离到一条切线上了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老数学家不会死，他们只是越扯越“切题”了。
explanatory_translation: 老数学家不会死，他们只是“离题”了；这里利用了 go off on a tangent 的“跑题”义，以及 tangent 在数学中的“切线”义。
interpretation_1: They ramble or digress from the main topic.
interpretation_2: Mathematicians are linked to the mathematical meaning of tangent, a geometric term.

surface_text: The novelist cut three chapters and called it streamlining by fiction.
interpretation_1_zh: 小说家说自己删掉三章是在减少写作推进中的阻力，让结构更顺。
interpretation_1_en: The novelist said cutting three chapters was a way of reducing friction and streamlining the manuscript.
interpretation_2_zh: 但他说成 by fiction，又暗示这种“精简”本身就是通过小说文本来实现的，甚至带一点作家式自我辩解。
interpretation_2_en: But phrasing it as by fiction also points to the fact that the streamlining happens through fiction itself, with a faintly self-justifying writerly twist.
context: A novelist removed three chapters from a manuscript and humorously described the editing process with a phrase altered from a familiar expression.
literal_translation: 这位小说家删掉了三章，并把这叫作“通过小说来精简”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位小说家砍掉三章，笑称这是“以小说之名瘦身”。
explanatory_translation: 这位小说家删掉了三章，并戏称这是“通过 fiction（小说/虚构）来精简”，这里借近音改写了类似 'streamlining by friction' 的说法，用 fiction 来呼应小说家的身份和删改行为。
interpretation_1: The novelist says cutting three chapters is a way of making the book more streamlined through fiction writing.
interpretation_2: It echoes the phrase 'streamlining by friction,' replacing 'friction' with 'fiction' to jokingly suggest editing through the novelist's medium.

surface_text: Our legal intern organized the case files with folderal precision.
interpretation_1_zh: 我们的法律实习生整理案卷时非常严谨、规整。
interpretation_1_en: Our legal intern organized the case files with great precision and proper order.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个词把 folder 塞进 formal 一类词形里，突出她对文件夹和案卷归类的精细。
interpretation_2_en: The blend inserts 'folder' into a form resembling 'formal,' emphasizing document folders and filing order.
context: A legal intern is organizing case files into folders; the legal setting activates 'federal' while the filing task activates 'folder.'
literal_translation: 我们的法律实习生以“文件夹式/联邦式”的精确度整理了案件档案。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们的法律实习生整理案卷时，精准得简直有种“卷宗夹级”的专业范儿。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 federal 和 folder 混成了 folderal：表面上像说一种很正式、很法律化的精确，实际上又点出他是在用文件夹整理案件档案。
interpretation_1: It describes the intern's precision as highly formal or legal-like, echoing 'federal precision.'
interpretation_2: It humorously suggests precision related to folders, since the intern is organizing files into folders.

surface_text: The librarian wanted a quieter return, so I muted my phone and brought the book back without fanfare.
interpretation_1_zh: 图书管理员想让还书过程更安静，所以我把手机静音了。
interpretation_1_en: The librarian wanted the book return process to be less noisy, so I muted my phone.
interpretation_2_zh: 这话也可以理解为我本人“回来”时别太高调，所以我悄悄把书还了。
interpretation_2_en: It can also mean my own return should be less conspicuous, so I brought the book back without fanfare.
context: 图书管理员说想要一个更安静的 return，叙述者于是把手机静音并低调地去还书。
negative_example: The librarian wanted a quicker return, so I hurried back with the book.
literal_translation: 图书管理员想要一次更安静的归还，所以我把手机静音了，并且不声张地把书带回来。
functional_equivalence_translation: 图书管理员说还书得安静点，我就把手机调成静音，悄没声地把书还了。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 return 一方面指“还书”，另一方面也可理解为“回归/现身”。因此说要一个更安静的 return，既像是在说安静地还书，也像是在说低调地回归、不制造动静。
interpretation_1: bringing a library book back
interpretation_2: a comeback or arrival done quietly, without noise or attention

surface_text: " My pencil is blunt , " said Tom pointlessly .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说汤姆因为铅笔很钝、没有笔尖，所以这句话是在“没有尖头地”说出来。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means Tom said it in a way related to having no point, because his pencil was blunt and lacked a sharp tip.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是 pointlessly 也表示“毫无意义地、无谓地”，暗示汤姆这句话说得很无聊或没有意义。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that pointlessly also means 'meaninglessly' or 'to no purpose,' suggesting that Tom spoke in a pointless, futile way.
context: Tom says his pencil is blunt, which activates both the idiomatic meaning of pointless and the literal idea of lacking a point.
literal_translation: “我的铅笔很钝，”汤姆毫无意义地说道。
functional_equivalence_translation: “我的铅笔没尖了，”汤姆说得也很‘没点’。
explanatory_translation: “我的铅笔很钝，”汤姆说道。这里的 pointlessly 一方面表示“毫无意义地”，另一方面又呼应铅笔“没有笔尖”。
interpretation_1: in a pointless or futile manner
interpretation_2: with no point on the pencil because it is blunt

surface_text: The editor asked for more volume, in the anthology and on the podcast.
interpretation_1_zh: 编辑想让这套选集再出一卷、增加册数。
interpretation_1_en: The editor wanted another volume added to the anthology.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时也表示播客的音量需要更大一些。
interpretation_2_en: It also means the podcast needs to be louder in audio volume.
context: editor asked for more volume in two domains: an anthology and a podcast
literal_translation: 编辑要求更多的“volume”，在选集中要更多，在播客上也要更多。
functional_equivalence_translation: 编辑说还要更有“分量”——选集内容得更厚，播客声音也得更大。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 volume 一词双关：对 anthology 来说指篇幅/卷数，对 podcast 来说指音量。
interpretation_1: the amount of space or content in a book or anthology; also a book volume
interpretation_2: the loudness level of audio on a podcast

surface_text: The night-shift nurse offered me some tea and a little sympathesia.
interpretation_1_zh: 夜班护士给了我一些关心和安慰。
interpretation_1_en: The night-shift nurse showed me sympathy and comfort.
interpretation_2_zh: 这种安慰又像带了点“麻醉感”，让人情绪都缓下来了。
interpretation_2_en: Her kindness also felt numbing and soothing, like emotional anesthesia.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：夜班护士在照顾“我”，一边递茶一边表达安慰，因此触发 sympathy 与 anesthesia 的混合双关。
literal_translation: 那位值夜班的护士给了我一些茶，还有一点“同麻心”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 值夜班的护士递给我一杯茶，还顺带给了我一点“麻醉式安慰”。
explanatory_translation: The nurse offered tea and also “sympathesia,” a made-up blend of “sympathy” and “anesthesia,” implying both emotional comfort and a numbing, medically tinged soothing effect.
interpretation_1: The nurse offered emotional comfort or sympathy along with tea.
interpretation_2: The word humorously suggests a medical-sounding soothing effect, blending sympathy with anesthesia.

surface_text: I'm going to the guillotine at dawn and my wife has already collected my severance pay .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：说话人天亮时要被送上断头台处决，而他的妻子已经领到了因为他被“切断”头身而得到的补偿金。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the speaker is going to be executed by guillotine at dawn, and his wife has already collected a payment linked to his being literally severed.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借用了固定说法“severance pay”，它原本指员工被解雇、离职时拿到的遣散费。这里把“severance”一词的“分离、切断”字面义和“遣散费”的常用义叠加起来形成双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the fixed expression "severance pay," which normally means compensation given to an employee when they are dismissed or laid off. Here, "severance" also evokes literal physical severing by the guillotine, creating the pun.
context: A speaker says he will be executed by guillotine at dawn, so “severance pay” links job termination with literal severing of the head.
literal_translation: 我将在黎明时被送上断头台，而我妻子已经领了我的遣散费。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我天亮就要上断头台了，我妻子已经把我的“断头/遣散补偿金”领走了。
explanatory_translation: 我将在黎明时被送上断头台，而我妻子已经领了我的遣散费。这里的 severance pay 本义是“解雇补偿金”，同时又借 severance 表示“被切断、砍头”，形成双关。
interpretation_1: Compensation paid to someone when their employment is terminated.
interpretation_2: Payment associated with being physically severed, i.e. beheaded by the guillotine.

surface_text: A cardboard belt would be a waist of paper.
The florist told me the wedding plan needed more stems, so I expanded the family trees and ordered longer roses.
interpretation_1_zh: 花艺师说婚礼方案需要更多“主干/分支结构”，于是我把家族关系图补得更完整。
interpretation_1_en: The florist meant stems in the sense of structural roots or branching lines, so I expanded the family trees.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时 stems 也是真正的“花茎”，所以我订了更长茎的玫瑰。
interpretation_2_en: Stems also literally means flower stems, so I ordered longer-stemmed roses.
context: A florist says the wedding plan needs more stems, and the listener connects floral stems with tree stems, leading to talk of family trees and longer roses.
negative_example: The florist told me the wedding plan needed more leaves, so I ordered greener bouquets.
literal_translation: 花店老板告诉我婚礼方案需要更多的茎，所以我扩展了家谱，还订了更长的玫瑰。
functional_equivalence_translation: 花店老板说婚礼布置还缺点“枝干”，我一听就把家谱也加大了，还订了更长枝的玫瑰。
explanatory_translation: 花店老板说婚礼方案需要更多 flower stems（花茎），说话人却把 stems 联想到 tree stems（树干/枝干），于是顺势扯到 family trees（家谱），形成并置双关。
interpretation_1: The florist means flower stems are needed in the wedding arrangement.
interpretation_2: The speaker humorously interprets stems as parts of trees, extending it to family trees.

surface_text: The place that made rubber balls almost went bankrupt , but they bounced back .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说这家生产橡皮球的地方又弹了回来，呼应了橡皮球会反弹的物理特性。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says the place that made rubber balls bounced back, echoing the literal behavior of rubber balls that spring back when they hit something.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是这家公司虽然差点破产，但后来恢复了元气、重新振作起来了。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the company nearly went bankrupt but then recovered and became financially stable again.
context: 一家生产橡胶球的工厂差点破产，后来说它们“bounced back”
literal_translation: 那家制造橡胶球的地方差点破产，但他们弹了回来。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那家做橡胶球的厂子差点倒闭，但最后还是“弹”回来了。
explanatory_translation: 那家生产橡胶球的公司几乎破产了，但后来恢复了元气；这里的“bounced back”既可让人想到橡胶球会弹回，也表示公司在经济上东山再起。
interpretation_1: The rubber balls physically bounce back.
interpretation_2: The company recovered after nearly going bankrupt.

surface_text: She didn't marry the gardener . Too rough around the hedges .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是那个园丁在树篱周围修剪得很粗糙，园艺活干得不够精细。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the gardener was rough around the hedges, trimming or handling the hedges in a careless or clumsy way.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借用了固定说法“rough around the edges”，意思是这个人性格、举止或修养比较粗鲁、不够圆滑，只是把 edges 改成了与园丁相关的 hedges 来制造双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the idiom "rough around the edges," meaning someone is socially unpolished or somewhat crude, with "edges" replaced by the gardener-related "hedges."
context: A joke about a gardener as a potential husband; the idiom 'rough around the edges' is altered to fit his profession.
literal_translation: 她没有嫁给那个园丁。对冲篱来说太粗糙了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 她没嫁给那个园丁——毕竟他真是“粗糙在树篱上”，也就是“粗糙在边角上”。
explanatory_translation: 她没有嫁给那个园丁。原本英语习语是 'rough around the edges'，表示人不够圆滑、举止粗鲁；这里把 edges 换成了与园丁相关的 hedges，形成双关。
interpretation_1: The idiom would normally be 'rough around the edges', meaning socially unrefined.
interpretation_2: Because he is a gardener, 'hedges' is activated literally, referring to garden bushes.

surface_text: A waist is a terrible thing to mind.
What a charming doorway ! said Tom , entranced .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说汤姆被这个迷人的门口深深吸引，完全着迷了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means Tom was fascinated and captivated by the charming doorway.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是“entranced”还可拆解联想到“in a trance”或与“entrance”相关，既表示他着迷，也暗暗呼应了前面的“doorway/入口”，形成关于“入口”和“入迷”的双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that “entranced” echoes both “in a trance” and “entrance,” so it not only means he was captivated but also subtly plays on the idea of an entrance or doorway.
context: Tom comments on a doorway as charming, and the adverbial tag suggests both admiration and a trance-like reaction; 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: “多么迷人的门口啊！”汤姆着迷地说。
functional_equivalence_translation: “这门口真有魔力！”汤姆看得都像中了迷似的。
explanatory_translation: “多么迷人的门口啊！”汤姆说，既表示他被深深吸引，也暗含他仿佛陷入恍惚状态；这里用 entranced 同时激活“着迷”和“像进入 trance 一样”的意思。
interpretation_1: Tom is fascinated or delighted by the doorway.
interpretation_2: Tom is figuratively in a trance because of the doorway, highlighting an exaggerated state.

surface_text: Our chef values fresh dates, especially on the dessert board and on Friday night.
interpretation_1_zh: 主厨重视“新鲜的枣子/椰枣”，尤其是在甜点板上。
interpretation_1_en: The chef values fresh dates as a food ingredient, especially for desserts.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时也暗示他重视“新鲜愉快的约会”，尤其是在周五晚上。
interpretation_2_en: It also suggests he values enjoyable, lively romantic dates on Friday night.
context: chef, fresh, dessert board, and Friday night jointly activate the fruit meaning and the romantic outing meaning of dates
literal_translation: 我们的厨师很看重新鲜的枣，尤其是在甜点板上和周五晚上。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们的厨师很看重“dates”——甜点盘上的枣，还有周五晚上的约会。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 dates 是双关：一方面指甜点板上的椰枣/枣，另一方面指周五晚上的约会。
interpretation_1: sweet fruits served on the dessert board
interpretation_2: romantic appointments on Friday night

surface_text: Moving furniture can be exhausting.
The sleep clinic's new brochure is very restcriptive.
interpretation_1_zh: 这本宣传册是在说诊所对睡眠建议很严格、很有规定性。
interpretation_1_en: The brochure suggests the clinic gives strict, rule-based guidance about sleep.
interpretation_2_zh: 这个新造词也暗示内容是关于“休息”的，强调睡眠与休养。
interpretation_2_en: The coined word also highlights rest itself, implying the brochure is all about getting proper sleep.
context: sleep clinic; brochure introducing sleep-related services or advice
literal_translation: 这家睡眠诊所的新宣传册非常“休息式限制”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这家睡眠诊所的新宣传册很“休”条主义。
explanatory_translation: 这句话把 restrictive（限制性的、规定很多的）改成了 restcriptive，嵌入了 rest（休息），既表示宣传册语气很像在严格规定，又呼应了睡眠诊所的“休息”主题。
interpretation_1: The brochure is very restrictive or prescriptive in tone.
interpretation_2: The brochure is about sleep and rest, so the word also evokes rest.

surface_text: Hell ! I thought it didn't matter what you believed as long as you were sincere !
interpretation_1_zh: 表层上是在感叹或提到“地狱”，意思是：天哪，我原以为只要你是真诚的，信什么都无所谓。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it mentions or exclaims 'Hell': I thought it didn't matter what you believed as long as you were sincere.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是用“Hell!”来反讽这句话：如果“真诚地相信什么都行”是真的，那人就不会因为信错而下地狱；这里借“地狱”点出宗教信仰并非只靠真诚就够。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is ironic: by saying 'Hell!', the speaker suggests that if sincerity alone were enough, people wouldn't end up in hell for believing the wrong thing. The word invokes religious damnation to challenge the idea.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话者似乎在死后或面对地狱时，讽刺地意识到自己先前认为“信什么都无所谓，只要真诚就行”的想法错了。
literal_translation: 地狱！我原以为你信什么都不要紧，只要你是真诚的！
functional_equivalence_translation: 见鬼！我还以为信什么都无所谓，只要够真诚就行！
explanatory_translation: “Hell!” 既像一句愤怒/震惊的感叹，又让人联想到“地狱”，暗示说话者可能已经下了地狱，因此讽刺地发现“信什么都无所谓”其实并不成立。
interpretation_1: The speaker exclaims with the word 'Hell!' as an emotional outburst.
interpretation_2: The word also invokes the literal idea of hell, fitting the implied context of someone discovering belief does matter after death.

surface_text: It's just like a cowboy to stirrup trouble .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上看，这句话是说牛仔总会用“马镫”去制造麻烦，带有把马具动作字面化的幽默感。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the sentence suggests that a cowboy would literally use a stirrup to cause trouble, creating humor through the horse-riding image.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把固定说法“stir up trouble”故意改成了“stirrup trouble”，借“stirrup”和“stir up”近音来表达“牛仔总爱惹事生非”。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a play on the phrase “stir up trouble,” altered to “stirrup trouble.” Because “stirrup” sounds like “stir up,” it implies that a cowboy is the kind of person who likes to cause trouble.
context: cowboy 与 trouble 同现，使 stir up trouble 与 stirrup 发生双关联想
literal_translation: 这就像牛仔会“马镫”麻烦一样。
functional_equivalence_translation: 牛仔就是爱“惹”麻烦——还惹得很有马具特色。
explanatory_translation: 这里把常见短语 stir up trouble（煽动/挑起麻烦）故意写成与 stirrup（马镫）同音的形式，借牛仔意象构成双关。
interpretation_1: A cowboy tends to cause or provoke trouble.
interpretation_2: The wording evokes a cowboy-related object, the stirrup, to fit the cowboy theme.

surface_text: The novelist's deadline turned every cup of tea into anxie-tea.
interpretation_1_zh: 小说家的截稿期让她每喝一杯茶都充满焦虑。
interpretation_1_en: The novelist's deadline made every cup of tea feel loaded with anxiety.
interpretation_2_zh: anxie-tea 把 anxiety 和 tea 拼在一起，表示她喝的不是放松茶，而是“焦虑茶”。
interpretation_2_en: The blend combines anxiety and tea, suggesting that the tea itself has become a symbol of deadline stress.
context: A novelist is under deadline pressure and is drinking tea; the stress changes how the tea is perceived.
literal_translation: 这位小说家的截止日期把每一杯茶都变成了“焦茶”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 小说家赶稿赶得，每杯茶都喝出了“焦虑茶”的味道。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 anxiety 和 tea 拼成 anxie-tea，表示小说家因截止日期压力太大，连喝茶都带着焦虑感。
interpretation_1: Because of the novelist's deadline, every cup of tea feels associated with anxiety.
interpretation_2: The word blends anxiety with tea, suggesting the tea itself has become anxiety-inducing.

surface_text: " Do you buy and sell stolen goods ? " asked Tom offensively .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说汤姆带着冒犯、无礼的口气问：‘你买卖赃物吗？’
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means Tom asked rudely or in an offensive manner, 'Do you buy and sell stolen goods?'
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把常见的 said/asked defensively 之类改成了 offensively，既表示他说话很冒犯，也暗示他像在主动发起“进攻”式指控，形成语义上的双关效果。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that 'offensively' plays against the more expected wording like 'defensively': it means not only that Tom spoke offensively, but also that he was going on the offensive by aggressively accusing the person.
context: 问句内容是“你买卖赃物吗”，其中 stolen goods 的销赃者可称 fence，因此 offensively 可被重新切分为 of-fensively。
literal_translation: “你买卖赃物吗？”汤姆冒犯地问道。
functional_equivalence_translation: “你是不是在销赃？”汤姆问得很‘犯规’。
explanatory_translation: “你买卖赃物吗？”汤姆带着双关意味地问道：表面上是说他问得很冒犯，隐含上利用 fence 可指‘销赃者’，把 offensively 戏仿成与 fence 相关的说法。
interpretation_1: Tom asked in an offensive or insulting manner.
interpretation_2: Tom asked in a way suggesting fencing, i.e. dealing in stolen goods.

surface_text: The poet-barber is famous for close lines; his verses and his shaves leave little behind.
interpretation_1_zh: “close lines”指诗行写得紧凑、凝练，没有多余成分。
interpretation_1_en: Close lines refers to tightly written poetic lines that are concise and controlled.
interpretation_2_zh: 它也呼应理发时的“贴面剃刮”，意思是他刮胡子也刮得很干净。
interpretation_2_en: It also evokes a close shave, meaning his barber work leaves very little stubble behind.
context: A person is both a poet and a barber; “lines” fits poetry, while “leave little behind” activates the shaving sense of closeness.
literal_translation: 这位诗人理发师因“贴近的诗行”而出名；他的诗句和他的剃须都几乎不留下什么。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位诗人兼理发师以“短到贴皮”的行句出名；不管写诗还是刮脸，都几乎不留余地。
explanatory_translation: 这句话把诗歌中的“lines”与理发中的“close shave”并置：表面上说他写的是简洁、紧凑的诗行，实际上也暗示他刮胡子刮得很干净，几乎不剩胡茬。
interpretation_1: The poet writes tight, concise poetic lines.
interpretation_2: The barber gives very close shaves, leaving almost no hair.

surface_text: Sweet potatoes ? I yam impressed !
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是在说“甜薯？我对山药/番薯印象深刻”，把“yam”当作食物名称来理解。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means “Sweet potatoes? I am impressed,” with “yam” understood as the vegetable.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把“I am impressed”故意说成“I yam impressed”，利用“yam”和“am”发音相近来制造笑点。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is the normal phrase “I am impressed,” deliberately changed to “I yam impressed” because “yam” sounds like “am.”
context: 前文提到 sweet potatoes，使 "I yam impressed" 中的 "yam" 可被识别为对 "I am impressed" 的食物化替换。
literal_translation: 红薯？我“山药”印象深刻！
functional_equivalence_translation: 说到红薯？我“薯”实佩服！
explanatory_translation: 这里把正常说法 "I am impressed" 里的 am 换成了与 sweet potatoes 相关的 yam，形成谐音式双关。
interpretation_1: The speaker says "I am impressed."
interpretation_2: Because the topic is sweet potatoes, "am" is replaced by "yam" to echo the vegetable.

surface_text: The new dog trainer answered every beginner question with leashurely patience.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是训犬师以从容、不急躁的方式回答问题。
interpretation_1_en: The surface meaning is that the trainer answered questions in a leisurely, patient way.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是这个词嵌入了 leash，呼应牵引绳和训犬工作。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning comes from inserting leash, which ties the patience to dog-training and leashes.
context: A dog trainer is answering beginner questions patiently.
literal_translation: 这位新训狗师用“牵绳般从容”的耐心回答了每一个初学者的问题。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位新训狗师回答每个新手问题时，都带着一种“牵绳式”的从容耐心。
explanatory_translation: 原文把 leisurely（从容地）改成 leashurely，嵌入了 leash（狗绳），既表示他回答问题很从容，也呼应了训狗师的身份。
interpretation_1: He answered in a leisurely, unhurried way.
interpretation_2: The word also evokes leash, linking his patience to dog training.

surface_text: Local business owner awards were announced today.
Our sleep-deprived editor submitted a yawnuscript at dawn.
interpretation_1_zh: 编辑在清晨提交了一份稿件。
interpretation_1_en: The editor submitted a manuscript at dawn.
interpretation_2_zh: 这份稿件是他困得直打哈欠时完成的，带有强烈困倦感。
interpretation_2_en: The manuscript was produced in a state of yawning exhaustion.
context: A sleep-deprived editor submitted something at dawn; the fatigue context activates "yawn" inside "manuscript".
literal_translation: 我们那位睡眠不足的编辑在黎明时提交了一份“哈欠稿”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我们那位困到打哈欠的编辑天一亮就交了一份“哈欠稿”。
explanatory_translation: 我们那位睡眠不足的编辑在黎明时交了一份稿子；原文把 manuscript 改成 yawnuscript，将 yawn（打哈欠）嵌入其中，突出他困得直打哈欠。
interpretation_1: The editor submitted a manuscript at dawn.
interpretation_2: Because the editor was sleep-deprived, the submitted manuscript is framed as a yawning manuscript, linking it to tiredness and yawning.

surface_text: By yourself you're in the right . In a group you're in the throng .
interpretation_1_zh: 字面上说，一个人独自站着时是在右边；而和一群人在一起时，则身处人群之中。
interpretation_1_en: Literally, when you are by yourself, you are on the right; when you are in a group, you are in the throng, that is, among the crowd.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借固定表达制造对照：独自一人时你往往是“对的”；而一旦进入群体，就容易陷入“人云亦云”的大众之中，不再显得正确或独立。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning contrasts being individually 'right' with being absorbed into the crowd: alone, you may be correct or independent, but in a group, you become part of the mass and lose that distinct correctness.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：句子将“by yourself”与“in a group”对比，并用“right”与“throng”形成机智对照。
literal_translation: 独自一人时，你是对的。身处群体时，你就在群众之中。
functional_equivalence_translation: 一个人时你总觉得自己站在理这边；一群人时你不过是挤在人群里。
explanatory_translation: 这句话把“be in the right（有理、正确）”和“be in the throng（在人群中）”并列对照，利用单独一人与群体状态的反差制造幽默。
interpretation_1: Alone, you are correct or on the correct side.
interpretation_2: In a group, the contrasted idea is being in a crowd, creating a play between being right and being in the throng.

surface_text: A case of disappearing bison had police completely buffaloed.
A cutlery manufacturing company was built at a fork in the road.
A third-generation clothes designer had it in her jeans.
I tried to look up impotence on the Internet but nothing came up .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：我试着在网上查“阳痿”这个词，但搜索结果什么都没有出现。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means: I tried to search for impotence on the Internet, but no results appeared.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是把“came up”理解为“勃起起来了”，于是这句话借“什么都没起来”来影射“阳痿”本身就是无法勃起。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that 'came up' also suggests 'rose' or 'got erect,' so 'nothing came up' humorously implies impotence itself—nothing could get up.
context: A person says they searched online for information about impotence, and the phrase 'nothing came up' can describe both no search results and no erection.
negative_example: I tried to look up insomnia on the Internet but nothing came up.
literal_translation: 我试着在网上查阳痿，但是什么都没有出来。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我上网查阳痿，结果什么都“没起来”。
explanatory_translation: 我试着在网上查阳痿，但什么都没有显示出来；这里的“came up”既指搜索结果没有出现，也暗指和阳痿相关的“没有勃起”。
interpretation_1: The search returned no results on the Internet.
interpretation_2: Nothing rose up, echoing the meaning of impotence as inability to achieve an erection.

surface_text: At a pet store :'buy one dog , get one flea'.
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是宠物店在促销：买一只狗，就免费得到一只跳蚤。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it sounds like a pet store promotion: buy one dog and get one flea for free.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是讽刺狗常常会带跳蚤；也就是你买一只狗，往往会附带跳蚤，并不是真正的优惠赠品。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a joke that dogs often come with fleas; if you buy a dog, you may end up getting a flea as an unwanted extra rather than a real free gift.
context: 宠物店促销广告语“buy one dog, get one ...”这一固定搭配可触发对 free 的预期，而 dog 又引出 flea 的联想。
negative_example: At a pet store: buy one dog, get one fly.
literal_translation: 在一家宠物店：“买一只狗，送一只跳蚤。”
functional_equivalence_translation: 在宠物店：买一送一——买狗送“蚤”。
explanatory_translation: 这句把促销语里常见的 free（免费赠送）换成与其同音的 flea（跳蚤）；表面像是“买一只狗送一只跳蚤”，实际是在利用狗常带跳蚤来制造双关。
interpretation_1: A promotional slogan normally means buy one dog and get another one free.
interpretation_2: Because dogs often have fleas, buying one dog may also get you a flea.

surface_text: The night baker calls his late shift the yawnut batch.
interpretation_1_zh: 这个夜班面包师说自己做的是一批甜甜圈。
interpretation_1_en: The baker is referring to a batch of doughnuts made during the late shift.
interpretation_2_zh: 因为值夜班太困，这批甜甜圈也像“打哈欠圈”一样。
interpretation_2_en: Because the shift is late and tiring, the doughnuts become 'yawnuts,' linking them to yawning.
context: 夜班烘焙师在深夜工作，把自己做的 doughnut batch 戏称为 yawnut batch，以突出困倦感。
literal_translation: 那位夜班面包师把他的晚班叫作“哈欠甜甜圈批次”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位夜班面包师把晚班做的甜甜圈叫作“哈欠圈”那一炉。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 doughnut 改成 yawnut，嵌入 yawn（打哈欠），表示这是夜班里让人犯困的一批甜甜圈。
interpretation_1: A batch of doughnuts made during the late shift.
interpretation_2: A sleepy late-night batch, with 'yawn' highlighting the baker's tiredness.

surface_text: It was raining cats and dogs . There were poodles all over the road .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上看，这句话把习语“下着倾盆大雨”按字面理解成真的有猫和狗从天上掉下来，所以路上到处都是贵宾犬。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the idiom 'raining cats and dogs' is taken literally, as if actual cats and dogs were falling from the sky, leaving poodles all over the road.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义其实是前一句本来只是说雨下得很大，而后一句故意接着把这个习语字面化，制造出“狗真的出现了”的荒诞幽默。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that the first sentence normally just means it was raining very heavily, and the second sentence humorously literalizes the idiom by pretending that real dogs actually appeared.
context: 前句使用固定表达“raining cats and dogs”表示下大雨，后句把雨后路面常见的“puddles”替换成近音的“poodles”。
literal_translation: 天在下倾盆大雨。路上到处都是贵宾犬。
functional_equivalence_translation: 雨下得像倒盆一样，路上尽是“狗坑”一样的贵宾犬/水坑。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 poodles（贵宾犬）说成路上到处都是，实际上借其与 puddles（水坑）近音形成双关；前文“raining cats and dogs”又把大雨和动物意象联系起来。
interpretation_1: 路上到处都是贵宾犬。
interpretation_2: 路上到处都是水坑，呼应大雨后的情景。

surface_text: A farmer with a rip in his clothes has an overall problem.
Betty Crocker was a flour child .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是贝蒂·克罗克是一个“面粉做的孩子”或与面粉有关的孩子。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it says that Betty Crocker was a “flour child,” a child made of or associated with flour.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是在借用短语“flower child”，指嬉皮文化中的“花之子”；这里把 flower 换成了同音的 flour，呼应贝蒂·克罗克与烘焙、面粉的关联。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on the phrase “flower child,” referring to a hippie-type figure; “flower” is replaced with the homophone “flour” to connect Betty Crocker with baking and flour.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：Betty Crocker与烘焙、面粉有关；原短语“flower child”是常见表达。
literal_translation: 贝蒂·克罗克是个“面粉孩子”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 贝蒂·克罗克可真是个“面粉花童”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把固定说法“flower child（嬉皮青年）”中的 flower 换成同音的 flour（面粉），借 Betty Crocker 的烘焙形象制造双关。
interpretation_1: Betty Crocker is described as a child associated with flour, fitting her baking brand image.
interpretation_2: It echoes the phrase "flower child," meaning a hippie or counterculture youth.

surface_text: She got fired from the hot dog stand for putting her hair in a bun .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是她在卖热狗的摊位工作时，把头发盘成了一个发髻，因此被开除了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, she was fired from the hot dog stand because she put her hair up in a bun hairstyle.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是“bun”也指热狗面包，这让人联想到她把头发放进了热狗的面包里，形成食物与发型之间的双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that "bun" also means the bread roll used for a hot dog, suggesting she put her hair in a hot dog bun, creating a pun between the hairstyle and the food item.
context: 在热狗摊工作，句中先提到 hot dog stand，随后说把 her hair in a bun，从而同时激活面包和发髻两义。
negative_example: She got fired from the hot dog stand for putting her hair in a bagel.
literal_translation: 她因为把她的头发放进一个小圆面包里而被热狗摊解雇了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 她在热狗摊被炒了，因为她把头发盘成了“面包”。
explanatory_translation: 她在热狗摊被解雇了，因为句中的 bun 既可以指热狗面包，也可以指盘起来的发髻，形成双关。
interpretation_1: A bread roll used for a hot dog.
interpretation_2: A hairstyle where hair is gathered into a round knot.

surface_text: My name is Pat . I am a masseur
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是在自我介绍：我叫 Pat，我是一名按摩师。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the speaker is simply introducing himself: his name is Pat, and he is a masseur.
interpretation_2_zh: 双关点在于名字 Pat 让人联想到动词 pat（轻拍、拍打），这和按摩时用手拍打身体的动作相关，因此名字和职业形成了巧合式双关。
interpretation_2_en: The pun is that the name Pat also evokes the verb 'pat,' meaning to tap or lightly strike, which relates to the hand movements used in massage, creating a wordplay between the name and the job.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话者先自我介绍叫 Pat，随后说明自己是按摩师，从而激活 pat 作为轻拍动作的含义。
literal_translation: 我叫帕特。我是一名按摩师。
functional_equivalence_translation: 我叫 Pat，职业正好也挺“拍”得上——我是按摩师。
explanatory_translation: 我叫 Pat。我是一名按摩师。这里利用了名字 Pat 与单词 pat 同音；pat 有“轻拍、拍打”的意思，和按摩师的工作动作相关。
interpretation_1: Pat is introduced as the speaker's personal name.
interpretation_2: pat means a light touch or tap, which relates to massage work.

surface_text: The butcher backed up into the meat grinder and got a little behind in his work .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：这个屠夫倒退着撞上了绞肉机，结果身体后部被卷进去了一点。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the butcher backed into the meat grinder and literally lost a little of his backside.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：他在工作进度上有点落后了，也就是工作耽搁了、没跟上进度。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that he fell a little behind in his work, meaning he became delayed or lagged behind schedule.
context: 屠夫倒退撞上绞肉机，随后说他在工作上有点 behind
literal_translation: 那个屠夫倒退着撞上了绞肉机，结果他的工作有点落在了后面。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个屠夫倒着撞上了绞肉机，结果工作进度和屁股都“落后”了一点。
explanatory_translation: 那个屠夫倒退时撞上了绞肉机，于是他说自己在工作上有点 behind。这里 behind 一方面表示“进度落后”，另一方面又让人联想到“屁股/身后部位”受了伤。
interpretation_1: delayed in his work; not keeping up with the workload
interpretation_2: the back part of his body was literally affected by backing into the meat grinder

surface_text: A wig van blew up on the motorway - police are combing the area .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：一辆运送假发的货车在高速公路上爆炸了，警方正在“梳理”这一带，到处仔细搜索。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that a van carrying wigs blew up on the motorway, and the police are thoroughly searching the area.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是利用“comb”既可表示“仔细搜查”，也可指“用梳子梳头”的双关；因为货车装的是假发，所以“combing the area”也让人联想到警方像在梳理头发或假发一样处理现场。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a pun on “comb,” which can mean both “to search thoroughly” and “to comb hair.” Since the van was carrying wigs, “combing the area” also evokes the image of literally combing hair or wigs.
context: A van carrying wigs exploded on the motorway, so the mention of wigs activates the hair-related sense in 'police are combing the area'.
literal_translation: 一辆假发车在高速公路上爆炸了——警方正在“梳理”该地区。
functional_equivalence_translation: 一辆运送假发的货车在高速上爆炸了——警方正对现场展开“梳”式搜查。
explanatory_translation: 一辆运送假发的车在高速公路上爆炸了——警方正在全面搜查现场；这里的“combing”本义也可指“用梳子梳”，因假发语境形成双关。
interpretation_1: Police are thoroughly searching the area.
interpretation_2: The verb also evokes using a comb, fitting the context of wigs and hair.

surface_text: A politician decided to resign on the day of an eclipse because it was a dark day.
The bullfighter's display of timidity left macho to be desired .
interpretation_1_zh: 这名斗牛士表现得很胆怯，所以他的男子气概还远远不够，仍有待加强。
interpretation_1_en: The bullfighter acted timidly, so his manliness or macho quality was lacking and left much to be desired.
interpretation_2_zh: 这里把固定说法“left much to be desired”改成了“left macho to be desired”，用“macho”替换“much”，借音近制造笑点，强调他一点也不勇猛、不够有男子汉气概。
interpretation_2_en: The joke twists the idiom 'left much to be desired' into 'left macho to be desired.' 'Macho' echoes 'much,' creating a sound-based pun that highlights how unbrave and unmanly the bullfighter seemed.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：说话者评价一位斗牛士的怯懦表现，与人们对其男子气概的期待形成反差。
negative_example: The bullfighter's display of timidity left match to be desired.
literal_translation: 这位斗牛士表现出的怯懦让“男子气概”仍有待追求。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位斗牛士太怯场了，离“猛男范儿”还差得远。
explanatory_translation: 原句仿照固定说法“left much to be desired（远不能令人满意）”，把 much 换成近音的 macho，既保留“很不理想”的意思，又额外点出斗牛士缺乏应有的男子气概。
interpretation_1: The bullfighter's timid performance left much to be desired.
interpretation_2: Because a bullfighter is expected to be manly, his timidity left macho to be desired, meaning it lacked machismo.

surface_text: A boy told his parents he wanted to raise goats for a living, but he was only kidding.
Suicide at sea is definitely going overboard .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说，在海上自杀就是“翻落船外”或“掉到船外”，与海上场景直接相关。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that suicide at sea literally involves going overboard, that is, falling or jumping off a ship into the water.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是“做得太过火、太极端”。这句话借用 overboard 的常见引申义，讽刺地说海上自杀真是把事情做到了极端。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is “going too far” or “being excessive.” It plays on the idiomatic sense of overboard to suggest that suicide at sea is taking things to an extreme.
context: A remark about suicide at sea, where both the idiomatic sense of excess and the literal nautical sense of going off a ship are available.
literal_translation: 海上自杀绝对算是“过火”了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 在海上自杀，真是“太过头”，也真会“翻出船外”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 overboard 一方面是固定说法 go overboard，意为“做得太过、过火”；另一方面在海事语境里又可按字面理解为“落到船外、翻出船外”。
interpretation_1: The idiom means going too far or becoming excessive.
interpretation_2: In a sea context, it literally suggests falling or jumping off the ship into the water.

surface_text: Some resist having the'flu jab but it's quite innocuous .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：有些人抗拒打流感疫苗这一针，但其实这针是相当无害的。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means some people resist getting the flu jab, but the injection is actually quite harmless.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是利用 jab 的双关：jab 不仅指“注射一针”，也可指“猛戳、轻捅、挖苦一下”。句子借此暗示这一下并不厉害、没有伤害性。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on 'jab': it means not only a vaccine injection, but also a poke, prod, or slight verbal dig. The sentence suggests that this 'jab' is not really harmful or severe.
context: flu jab；根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 有些人抗拒打流感针，但它其实相当无害。
functional_equivalence_translation: 有些人抗拒这记“流感一针”，可它其实并不伤人。
explanatory_translation: 有些人抗拒打流感疫苗；这里 jab 一方面指“注射”，另一方面也让人联想到“戳一下、打一下”，形成轻微双关，但句子强调它其实是无害的。}
interpretation_1: a vaccination injection for flu
interpretation_2: a poke or hit, suggesting something aggressive or harmful

surface_text: If all your troubles are melting away watch out for the floods .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：如果你所有的麻烦都像冰雪一样融化消失了，那就要小心会发洪水。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means: if all your troubles are literally melting away like ice or snow, watch out for floods.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：如果你的烦恼正在逐渐消失，那本来是好事；后半句故意把“融化”按字面理解，制造出“烦恼消失会导致洪水”的荒诞双关效果。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is: if your troubles are gradually disappearing, that is normally a good thing; the second half deliberately treats “melting away” literally, creating the absurd pun that disappearing troubles could cause floods.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：先说 troubles are melting away，再说 watch out for the floods，把惯用的比喻义转成了字面义
negative_example: If all your troubles are going away watch out for the floods.
literal_translation: 如果你所有的麻烦都在融化消失，小心洪水。
functional_equivalence_translation: 如果你的烦恼都在“融化”，那可得当心发大水了。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 melting away 从“逐渐消失”的比喻义，临时转成了“真的融化成水”，所以才会接上 floods 的字面玩笑。
interpretation_1: your troubles are gradually disappearing
interpretation_2: the troubles are literally melting and producing water, which could cause floods

surface_text: The pet groomer wanted a smoother coat, so I brushed the terrier and softened my winter jacket.
interpretation_1_zh: 宠物美容师想让狗毛更顺滑，所以我给那只梗犬梳了毛。
interpretation_1_en: The groomer wanted the dog's fur coat to be smoother, so I brushed the terrier.
interpretation_2_zh: 她的话也让人想到衣服外套，所以我把自己的冬季外套处理得更柔软。
interpretation_2_en: Her wording also suggests a clothing coat, so I softened my winter jacket.
context: pet groomer, brushed the terrier, and softened my winter jacket all make both senses of coat active
literal_translation: 宠物美容师想要一件更顺滑的外套，所以我给那只梗犬梳了毛，还把我的冬季夹克弄得更柔软。
functional_equivalence_translation: 宠物美容师说想让“coat”更顺滑，于是我一边给梗犬顺毛，一边把自己的冬衣也弄软了。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 coat 是双关：一方面指梗犬的被毛，另一方面指人的外套。说要让 coat 更顺滑，于是前半句对应给狗梳毛，后半句对应把冬季夹克变柔软。
interpretation_1: the fur of the terrier being groomed
interpretation_2: a winter jacket worn by a person

surface_text: The seafood lawyer prepared a shellf-defense for the crab vendor.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是，这位处理海鲜案子的律师为卖蟹人准备了一个“带壳式辩护”。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the seafood lawyer devised a 'shell-based defense' for the crab vendor.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是影射 self-defense（自卫/正当防卫），因为对象是有壳的螃蟹摊主，所以改成 shellf-defense。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden reading plays on 'self-defense,' replacing 'self' with 'shell' to match the crab-related legal setting.
context: seafood lawyer, crab vendor
literal_translation: 那位海鲜律师为蟹贩准备了一套“贝壳式/自我”辩护。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位海鲜律师为蟹贩准备了一套“壳卫”辩护。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 self-defense 改成 shellf-defense，借 shell 与 self 的近音，既表示“自我辩护”，又呼应螃蟹的壳。
interpretation_1: A lawyer prepared a legal argument of self-defense.
interpretation_2: Because the client is a crab vendor, the phrase also evokes a defense related to shells/crabs.

surface_text: Did you hear about the new pinata ? It's a huge hit .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：这个新皮纳塔很受欢迎，是个巨大的成功。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the new pi?ata is very popular and a huge success.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：皮纳塔本来就是要被人用棍子击打的，所以它真的是一个会被狠狠“打中”的东西。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that a pi?ata is literally something people hit with a stick, so it is a 'huge hit' in the physical sense as well.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：谈论一个新皮纳塔，评价它时用到“a huge hit”，同时皮纳塔会被人击打。
literal_translation: 你听说那个新的皮纳塔了吗？它是一个巨大的“击中/热门”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 你听说那个新皮纳塔了吗？它可真是“火”了——也特别经打。
explanatory_translation: 你听说那个新皮纳塔了吗？它真是个“大热门”。这里的 hit 一方面表示“热门、成功”，另一方面又指皮纳塔会被人反复击打。
interpretation_1: very successful or popular
interpretation_2: something that gets struck hard, as a pinata is hit

surface_text: A mathematician that couldn't stop adding up recently went incremental.
The software team asked for a smoother launch, so we fixed the bugs and picked a day without thunderstorms.
interpretation_1_zh: 软件团队想要一次更顺利的产品发布，所以我们修复了程序漏洞。
interpretation_1_en: The software team wanted a smoother product launch, so we fixed the bugs.
interpretation_2_zh: 同时，launch 也让人联想到发射、升空之类的启动场景，所以我们还挑了一个没有雷暴的日子。
interpretation_2_en: At the same time, launch evokes the idea of sending something off, like a real launch, so we also chose a day without thunderstorms.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：software team discussing a product launch, with both bug fixing and weather conditions treated as relevant to a smoother launch
literal_translation: 软件团队要求一次更顺利的发布，所以我们修复了漏洞，还挑了一个没有雷暴的日子。
functional_equivalence_translation: 软件团队想让这次“上线/发射”更顺利，于是我们一边修 bug，一边挑了个没有雷暴的日子。
explanatory_translation: 软件团队想要一次更顺利的“launch”。这个词既可指软件发布上线，也可指现实中的发射/起飞，因此后半句把修复软件漏洞和避开雷暴天气并列，形成双关。
interpretation_1: a software product release going smoothly
interpretation_2: a literal outdoor launch affected by weather such as thunderstorms

surface_text: The marine biologist gave our beach talk a wavefootnote at the end.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是：海洋生物学家在海滩讲座结尾补充了一个附带说明。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the marine biologist added a final footnote to the beach talk.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是：把 wave 拼到 footnote 前面，让这条“附注”带上海洋和海浪色彩。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that footnote is reshaped with wave, turning the closing remark into an ocean-themed add-on.
context: marine biologist, beach talk, and an ending note jointly license blending wave with footnote
literal_translation: 那位海洋生物学家在我们的海滩讲座结尾给了一个“海浪脚注”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那位海洋生物学家在海滩讲座最后加了个“浪注”。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 footnote（脚注/补充说明）和 wave（海浪）拼合成 wavefootnote，表示讲座结尾的补充说明被故意说成带有海滩海浪意味的“脚注”。
interpretation_1: The marine biologist ended the beach talk with a footnote or concluding note.
interpretation_2: The ending is humorously recast as a wave-related note, fitting the beach and marine context.

surface_text: For the office drunk : He generally found him loaded with work to do .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说，这个办公室里的酒鬼通常总是有很多工作要做，身上背着满满的工作任务。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the office drunk was generally burdened with a lot of work to do.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是“loaded”也可指喝醉了、酒气上头，所以这句话同时在说这个办公室酒鬼经常是醉醺醺的。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that 'loaded' can also mean drunk or intoxicated, so the sentence also suggests that the office drunk was often drunk.
context: 办公室里的酒鬼；句子说人们通常发现他“loaded with work to do”，其中 loaded 同时可理解为工作很多和喝醉了。
literal_translation: 对于办公室酒鬼：人们通常发现他满载着要做的工作。
functional_equivalence_translation: 说到办公室里的酒鬼，人们总见他不是忙得满身是活儿，就是醉得晕乎乎。
explanatory_translation: 对于办公室里的酒鬼：人们通常发现他“loaded with work to do”。这里 loaded 表层是“工作压身、任务很多”，同时又可指“喝醉了”，构成双关。
interpretation_1: He had a lot of work assigned to him.
interpretation_2: He was drunk, since loaded can mean intoxicated.

surface_text: The vet's pep talks are full of furmality when pets get nervous.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层意思是，兽医在宠物紧张时会用一种很“毛茸正式”的方式安抚它们。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the vet gives nervous pets pep talks with a kind of furry formality.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是由 fur 和 formality 拼成，既点出动物毛发，也暗示兽医讲话专业而郑重。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden reading blends 'fur' with 'formality,' linking the animal setting with the vet's calm, professional manner.
context: A veterinarian gives pep talks to nervous pets; the animal setting makes "fur" salient inside "formality."
literal_translation: 当宠物紧张时，兽医的打气谈话里充满了“毛”式正式感。
functional_equivalence_translation: 宠物一紧张，兽医的安抚话就特别“毛”重其事。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 formality（正式感）改成 furmality，嵌入了 fur（毛），既表示兽医说话很正式，又呼应宠物有毛的语境。
interpretation_1: The vet's pep talks sound formal or ceremonious.
interpretation_2: The word is altered to evoke animal fur, fitting the pet context.

surface_text: A tire store loves a chance to Roll out a new product .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：轮胎店很喜欢把新产品滚出来推出，好像轮胎真的在地上滚动一样。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means a tire store loves to literally roll out a new product, as if the product moves forward on wheels.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是："roll out" 也是英语里的固定表达，表示正式推出新产品。这里借轮胎会滚动的特点形成双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that "roll out" is a common expression meaning to officially launch a new product. The pun works because tires literally roll.
context: tire store; new product
literal_translation: 一家轮胎店喜欢有机会把新产品滚出来。
functional_equivalence_translation: 轮胎店最爱把新品“滚动推出”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 roll out 既指常见的“推出新产品”，又暗合轮胎会滚动这一字面含义。
interpretation_1: to introduce or launch a new product
interpretation_2: to literally roll something, fitting tires and wheels

surface_text: Since Bruce got too close to the big blade at the saw mill he is no longer feeling chipper .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上说的是，布鲁斯在锯木厂离大锯片太近之后，已经不再感到精神愉快、活力十足了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means that after Bruce got too close to the big blade at the saw mill, he is no longer feeling cheerful or lively.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把“chipper”联想到木片机或切成木片这层意思；在锯木厂的语境里，这暗示他被大锯片伤到，可能被切成了木屑或碎片。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on "chipper" as something related to a wood chipper or being chipped into pieces; in the sawmill context, it suggests he was injured by the blade and turned into chips or fragments.
context: Bruce got too close to the big blade at the saw mill.
literal_translation: 由于布鲁斯在锯木厂离大锯片太近了，他再也不觉得很快活了。
functional_equivalence_translation: 布鲁斯在锯木厂离大锯片太近，如今再也不“精神”了——也快成木屑了。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 chopper? No, chipper 一方面表示“快活的、精神好的”，另一方面又让人联想到 wood chips（木屑），因为他在锯木厂靠近大锯片，暗示他被锯成碎屑。
interpretation_1: feeling cheerful and lively
interpretation_2: turned into wood chips by the saw blade

surface_text: The trucker was always irritated at an inspection station , it was the weight that bothered him .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上是说卡车司机在检查站总是因为车辆的重量检测而感到烦躁，困扰他的是车子的重量问题。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means the trucker was always annoyed at the inspection station because the vehicle's weight was what caused him trouble.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是借用固定说法“something bothered him”中的心理负担感，把“weight”理解成一种让人烦心的负担或压力，因此既指货车重量，也暗指压在他心头的烦恼。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning plays on 'weight' as both the truck's physical weight and a figurative burden or pressure that was bothering him mentally.
context: 卡车司机在检查站接受称重检查，也可能因排队等待而烦躁。
negative_example: The trucker was always irritated at an inspection station; it was the scale that bothered him.
literal_translation: 那个卡车司机在检查站总是很恼火，困扰他的是“重量”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个卡车司机在检查站总是很恼火，真让他受不了的是“称重”也是“久等”。
explanatory_translation: 那个卡车司机在检查站总是很恼火：表面上说是车辆的重量让他烦，实际双关了与 weight 同音的 wait，意思也可能是等待时间让他烦。
interpretation_1: The trucker was bothered by the vehicle's weight being checked at the inspection station.
interpretation_2: The trucker was bothered by the wait or delay at the inspection station.

surface_text: Short stories and poems were required.
A pun is its own reword .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上这句话是在说：一个双关语本身就是对原话的一次重新措辞或改写。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the sentence says that a pun is itself a rewording or rephrasing of something.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把常见说法“a pun is its own reward”中的“reward”改成了近音的“reword”，既保留原句结构，又强调双关语是通过换词、改词产生的。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is a play on the familiar phrase “a pun is its own reward,” where “reward” is replaced by the similar-sounding “reword,” highlighting that a pun works by rewording or changing words.
context: 根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境：固定表达“its own reward”被改成“its own reword”，讨论对象是 pun。
negative_example: A pun is its own record.
literal_translation: 双关语是它自己的“重新措辞”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 双关语自有其“奖赏”，也自成一种“改词”。
explanatory_translation: 原句改写自固定说法“A pun is its own reward（双关语本身就是回报）”，把 reward 换成近音的 reword，既保留“回报”的原说法，又强调双关常通过“重新用词/改词”形成。
interpretation_1: A pun is its own reward.
interpretation_2: A pun is itself a re-wording, so it is its own reword.

surface_text: The rookie lawyer gave a nervdict before the jury did.
interpretation_1_zh: 这位新手律师好像抢先给出了一个判断。
interpretation_1_en: The rookie lawyer seemed to deliver a verdict before the jury.
interpretation_2_zh: 其实强调的是他紧张得把态度和表情都提前“宣判”出来了。
interpretation_2_en: The blend implies his nervousness gave away his judgment before the official verdict.
context: A rookie lawyer speaks before the jury reaches an official verdict, and his anxious state motivates the blend.
literal_translation: 那个新手律师在陪审团作出裁决之前，先给出了一个“紧张裁决”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个菜鸟律师紧张得抢在陪审团前，先来了个“慌决”。
explanatory_translation: 这里的 nervdict 是把 nervous 和 verdict 混成的新词，意思是那位新手律师因为紧张，竟像提前给出裁决一样先说了话。
interpretation_1: A mistaken or premature verdict-like statement was given.
interpretation_2: The lawyer was so nervous that his statement is framed as a nervous verdict.

surface_text: The chicken is ready to eat.
The Turkish soldier refused to eat cottage cheese , because he didn't trust the kurds
interpretation_1_zh: 表面意思是：那个土耳其士兵拒绝吃奶渣（cottage cheese），因为他不信任其中的凝乳块，也就是“curds”。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the Turkish soldier refused to eat cottage cheese because he didn't trust the curds in it.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含意思是：这里把“curds”说成了与其近音的“Kurds”，暗指土耳其士兵不信任库尔德人，因此形成双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that “kurds” sounds like “curds” and refers to Kurds, implying that the Turkish soldier did not trust Kurdish people.
context: 土耳其士兵、cottage cheese、trust the kurds/curds 共同触发食物义与族群义。
literal_translation: 那个土耳其士兵拒绝吃农家干酪，因为他不信任“库尔德人/凝乳”。
functional_equivalence_translation: 那个土耳其士兵不肯吃茅屋奶酪，因为他说自己不信“库尔德”，也不信“凝乳”。
explanatory_translation: 笑点在于 kurds 与 curds 同音：表面上像是说他不信任奶酪里的凝乳，隐含上又指作为土耳其士兵，他不信任库尔德人。
interpretation_1: He did not trust the curds in the cottage cheese.
interpretation_2: As a Turkish soldier, he did not trust Kurds, the ethnic group.

surface_text: The marine biologist studies current issues, in coastal waters and in the funding committee.
interpretation_1_zh: 表层义是：海洋生物学家研究海岸水域中的洋流相关问题。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, the marine biologist studies issues involving water currents in coastal areas.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是：他也要面对资助委员会里的当下现实问题。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning is that he also deals with current issues, meaning present-day problems, in the funding committee.
context: A marine biologist is described as studying "current issues" both in coastal waters and in a funding committee.
literal_translation: 这位海洋生物学家研究当前的问题，在沿海水域里，也在资助委员会里。
functional_equivalence_translation: 这位海洋生物学家研究“水流中的问题”，也研究“当下的问题”——前者在海边，后者在资助委员会。
explanatory_translation: 双关点在 current issues：在资助委员会里指“当前的重要议题”，在沿海水域里借 current 激活“水流、洋流”的意思，因此同时让人想到研究海流相关问题。
interpretation_1: The biologist studies issues that are currently important in the funding committee.
interpretation_2: The biologist studies water currents in coastal waters.

surface_text: OLD DIVERS never die , they just get board .
interpretation_1_zh: 表面上这句话是说：老潜水员不会死，他们只是变得无聊了。
interpretation_1_en: On the surface, it means: old divers never die; they just get bored.
interpretation_2_zh: 隐含义是把 bored 故意换成同音的 board，暗指潜水员会上船或接触船板，因此形成与潜水场景相关的双关。
interpretation_2_en: The hidden meaning comes from replacing bored with the homophone board, hinting that divers get on board or deal with boards/boats, creating a diving-related pun.
context: divers 与 board 共同激活 diving board 语境；根据表层文本可恢复的最小必要语境
literal_translation: 老潜水员永远不会死，他们只是变成了板子。
functional_equivalence_translation: 老跳水员不会死，他们只是觉得无聊，也只是上了跳板。
explanatory_translation: 这里把 bored（无聊的）替换成同音的 board（板子），借 divers 让人联想到 diving board，因此同时有“变得无聊”和“上了跳板”的双关。
interpretation_1: Old divers never die; they just become bored.
interpretation_2: Old divers never die; they end up on a board, evoking a diving board.

surface_text: A guy swallowed a spoon and found he couldn't stir.
A noun and a verb were dating but they broke up because the noun was too possessive.
A man brought his retriever to the vet for some tests and had to pay a lab fee.
